skycinemahits.uk.title: The Bourne Identity

(Action, Movie, Mystery, Thriller) - 2002-06-06

skycinemahits.uk.title: The Bourne Supremacy
skycinemahits.uk.description: Jason Bourne is living in India when he is framed by Russian agent Kirill for the theft of millions from the CIA. Kirill begins to pursue Bourne, intending to assassinate him, but while Bourne and his girlfriend, Marie, are on the run, a shot meant for him kills her instead. Vowing revenge, Bourne sets out to prove his innocence and bring the culprits to justice, but he has to evade CIA head Pamela Landry, who is convinced he is guilty. (Action, Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2004-07-23

skycinemahits.uk.title: The Bourne Ultimatum
skycinemahits.uk.description: A former CIA assassin continues his quest to fill in memory gaps. With some very powerful people intent on keeping their skeletons buried, he is in more danger than ever before, as his former paymasters send a series of elite killers after their reformed ex-colleague. (Action, Drama, Movie, Mystery, Thriller) - 2007-08-03

skycinemahits.uk.title: The Bourne Legacy
skycinemahits.uk.description: Agent Aaron Cross must use his genetically-enhanced skills to finish what Jason Bourne started in this action-packed hit that takes the Bourne series to explosive new levels. (Action, Movie, Thriller) - 2012-08-09

skycinemahits.uk.title: Jason Bourne

In discussion with the BBC's unparalleled range of experts across the world, he uses their unique local knowledge to go beyond the headlines to get to the unspun truth about the world.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: The Bidding Room
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S8 E18 Dinky and Corgi Cars, Marble Bust, Antique Stereoscope Toy seller Martin drives a hard bargain with the bidders with his Dinky and Corgi car collection, Debbie hopes her musical curiosity will strike a chord and dealer Jo is bewitched by a painting with a mysterious history. Presented by Nigel Havers, with auctioneer Simon Bower on hand to value the items.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Bridge of Lies
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S4 E18 Friends Alison, Sarah Jane, Ciaran and Alan compete for cash by crossing a bridge of stepping stones - making sure they avoid the lies. Game show, hosted by Ross Kemp.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Pointless
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S30 E42 Quiz show in which four pairs of contestants have to score the fewest points possible by giving the least obvious answers to questions posed to 100 people before the show. Presented by Alexander Armstrong and Sally Phillips.

bbconemidlands.uk.description: E7429 04/11/2026 Ian's bonfire night faces some hurdles, Max tries to diffuse the tension, and Gemma comes up with a plan to bring the women of Walford together.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S4 E2 Sam Ryder, Jeff Stelling and Ella Eyre, accompanied by friends or relatives, and Princess and Junior Andre continue their epic 7,500km race. The second leg takes the teams across the heart of Borneo to a modern metropolis on its eastern coast and their second checkpoint.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: MasterChef: The Professionals
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S19 E2 Marcus Wareing and Monica Galetti are joined by guest chef Santiago Lastra, who sets the contestants a challenge to come up with their own version of one of his most complex recipes - honey and chilli char-glazed duck breast, with Mexican sauce. The hopefuls then demonstrate their pastry knowledge in a signature dessert challenge.

bbconemidlands.uk.description: 04/11/2026 A round-up of today's headlines.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: MOTD: UEFA Champions League : 04/11/2026
bbconemidlands.uk.description: Action from the matchday four fixtures, including Barcelona v Aston Villa at Spotify Camp Nou and Fenerbahce v Liverpool at Sükrü Saracoglu Stadium. The Villans faced a tough test away to the Spanish champions, and Liverpool were looking to maintain their 100 per cent record in this season's competition when they made the trip to Turkey.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Office Christmas Party
bbconemidlands.uk.description: Festive comedy starring Jennifer Aniston and Jason Bateman. When CEO Carol Vanstone threatens drastic action to get the Chicago branch of the company back in the black, the staff and her branch manager brother decide to host a Christmas party memorable enough to impress a potential client and close a sale that will save their jobs.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Money for Nothing
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S14 E17 Sarah finds a set of dining chairs, a chipboard cabinet and a collection of vintage coat hangers at Wallyford recycling centre in East Lothian and enlists the help of Heather McFarlane and Daniel Heath to upcycle and sell them.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Escape to the Country
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S22 E21 Monmouthshire Sonali Shah helps a couple from London with a budget of £325,000 to find a new home in the Monmouthshire countryside. She also visits a market garden with an unusual growing method.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: The Bidding Room
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S7 E8 Vampire Killing Kit, Coco de Mer, Clockwork Spit Roast Nigel Havers meets Philip, who has come from Stoke with his vampire-killing kit, which includes a stake, holy water and various other accessories one might need when dealing with the undead. Other items are a pair of mourning brooches, popular in the mid-19th century, a clockwork spit roast and a rare seed from the Seychelles.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Bridge of Lies
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S4 E19 Quiz show hosted by Ross Kemp in which contestants compete for cash by crossing a bridge made up of stepping stones, each of which has a different option. Friends Aishwarya, Anand, Rachana and Anand must try to get from A to B by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies in order to cross the studio floor safely, or risk falling off the bridge and out of the game.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Pointless
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S30 E43 Quiz show in which four pairs of contestants have to score the fewest points possible by giving the least obvious answers to questions posed to 100 people before the show. At the end of each round, the team with the most points is eliminated until the final two pairs battle for a cash prize. Presented by Alexander Armstrong and Sally Phillips.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: MasterChef: The Professionals
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S19 E3 It's the first quarter-final, and the four chefs who have fought their way through the heats return to the kitchen with everything to play for. First up, the chefs face the invention test in which they must make a dish starring a surprise ingredient - coconut. The cooks must then serve a two-course meal for two of the country's most discerning food critics, William Sitwell and Xanthe Clay, alongside chef and writer Rahel Stephanie.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Sort Your Life Out with Stacey Solomon
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S5 E5 Introducing New Girl Band Rain and Shine The Bowens, a family of five, call on Stacey and her team to transform their home in Wales. Mum-of-four Katrina recently moved her family from the West Midlands to start a new chapter in the countryside as a single parent. But for a truly fresh start, they need to do some serious decluttering first.

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great British Railway Journeys - Warrington to Preston
eden.uk.plus1.description: Armed with his early 20th century Bradshaw's Guide, Michael Portillo embarks on a journey through Britain's industrial heartland in the footsteps of King George V. He starts in Warrington and learns how the mayor, Dr George Joseph, received the royal party in the parlour of Warrington's magnificent town hall. (Documentary, Travel) - 2019

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great British Railway Journeys - Manchester to Elsecar
eden.uk.plus1.description: In Manchester at the magnificent Heaton Park, Michael discovers one of the first open air concerts was held here in 1909 by an opera fan, William Grimshaw, who entertained 40,000 people to the music of opera superstar, Enrico Caruso, on a gramophone. (Documentary, Travel) - 2019

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great British Railway Journeys - Maltby to Hinckley
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael heads for Maltby, where he is caught up with the thrill of the chase as he investigates the high-octane sport of whippet racing. He learns how this `poor man's sport' grew during the 19th century in the mining towns of the north and retains its appeal today. (Documentary, Travel) - 2019

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great British Railway Journeys - Birmingham to the Potteries
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo reaches Birmingham and discovers how a radical reformer would make his mark on the city of a thousand trades. At Highbury Hall he finds Joseph Chamberlain's splendid mansion home and hears how he established a political dynasty including a Prime Minister and a Foreign Secretary. (Documentary, Travel) - 2019

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great British Railway Journeys - Blackburn to Manchester
eden.uk.plus1.description: In Blackburn Michael catches a rare glimpse of Edwardian life on celluloid and marvels at how factory workers and schoolchildren alike were drawn to seek fame on film. Continuing east to Nelson, Michael braves the enemy camp to have a pint of tea with the socialist working classes in Britain's last Clarion House. Way out of his comfort zone, he is heartened by their warm welcome. (Documentary, Travel) - 2019

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great British Railway Journeys
eden.uk.plus1.description: Early 20th century Britain was reeling from industrial strife and suffragette outrages but the biggest crisis of all was the conflict in Ireland. Beginning in Newry, Michael finds a specially chartered train would deliver demonstrators campaigning for Irish Home Rule to a rally in the town. (Documentary, Travel) - 2019

eden.uk.plus1.title: Africa from Above - Ghana
eden.uk.plus1.description: Explores Ghana's many natural and man-made wonders. Follows the Volta River as it flows from the Sahel savannahs, through fertile cocoa-laden hills at the heart of the nation, and across the biggest artificial lake in Africa.

eden.uk.plus1.title: Africa from Above - Ethiopia
eden.uk.plus1.description: Travels Ethiopia, the most populous landlocked country on Earth, to view its many sights. Highlights the work of communities that are planting trees to fight desertification and also visits Lake Tana, the country's largest lake.

eden.uk.plus1.title: Africa from Above - Uganda
eden.uk.plus1.description: A journey of discovery around Uganda, the `Pearl of Africa', that highlights the country's rich diversity in natural landscapes including glacier-tipped mountains, ancient rainforests and crater lakes. (Documentary, Nature) - 2022

eden.uk.plus1.title: Joanna Lumley's Silk Road Adventure
eden.uk.plus1.description: Starting in Venice Joanna sees how the travels of Venetian hero Marco Polo and Silk Road traders influenced its growth. In Albania, Joanna walks the beginning of the Via Egnatia - an ancient network that once linked the entirety of the Roman Empire. (Documentary, News, Travel) - 2018

eden.uk.plus1.title: Joanna Lumley's Silk Road - Georgia and Azerbaijan
eden.uk.plus1.description: Joanna follows the Silk Road from the Black Sea to the Caspian Sea, across the post-Soviet states of Georgia and Azerbaijan. On the way she learns not only about the history, but how these two very countries are still finding their identities. (Documentary, Travel) - 2018

eden.uk.plus1.title: Joanna Lumley's Silk Road - Iran
eden.uk.plus1.description: Joanna's Silk Road journey takes her to Iran. Throughout the country she meets people eager to share the culture and innovations of the Persian civilisation which, thanks to the Silk Road, spread far beyond modern-day Iran. (Documentary, Travel) - 2018

eden.uk.plus1.title: Joanna Lumley's Silk Road - Uzbekistan and Kyrgyzstan
eden.uk.plus1.description: As Joanna's Silk Road Adventure draws to a close, she travels across the stunning yet little-known Central Asian states of Uzbekistan and Kyrgyzstan. Starting in the Kyzl-Kum desert she explores the Silk Road citadel of Khiva, a town infamous for its history of slavery. In the capital, Tashkent, she marvels at the splendid Soviet-built Metro system and attends a high society wedding as the guest of a famous pop star. (Documentary, Travel) - 2018

stvnorth.uk.description: E10692 05/11/2026 Cain urges Kammy to stay quiet. Nicola opens up to Kev, while Caleb begins to panic.

stvnorth.uk.title: Coronation Street
stvnorth.uk.description: E11977 05/11/2026 Kit's outburst at work triggers calls for him to take sick leave, Idris looks forward to seizing control of the factory, Gemma hears from the hospital, and Debbie invites the girls over.

stvnorth.uk.title: Dear Henry: Our Fight for Justice - A Tonight Special
stvnorth.uk.description: S28 E8 The 2025 murder of 18-year-old Henry Nowak shocked millions after footage of his final moments came to light at the trial of his attacker in June this year. In an interview with Paul Brand, Henry's family share memories of a much-loved son and brother, while asking questions about the treatment he received, and the police investigation that followed.

stvnorth.uk.title: ITV News at Ten; Weather
stvnorth.uk.description: S11 E221 05/11/2026 A fresh perspective on the major stories of the day, featuring national and international news, with reports and analysis from ITV's correspondents.

stvnorth.uk.title: The World Is Not Enough
stvnorth.uk.description: Spy adventure starring Pierce Brosnan, Sophie Marceau and Robert Carlyle. After the death of oil magnate Sir Robert King in a booby trap, agent James Bond becomes bodyguard to King's daughter, Elektra, to protect her from her father's killer.

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Man With the Golden Arm (1955)
talkingpictures.uk.description: A professional card dealer comes out of a clinic supposedly having been cured of his heroin addiction. Things start to go wrong when his embittered wife persuades him to go back to his old job despite his plans to become a jazz drummer. (Drama) - 1955

talkingpictures.uk.title: Where Has Poor Mickey Gone? (1964)
talkingpictures.uk.description: Unseen for years this strange, B-Picture oddity sees ren Mitchell superb as fairground magician Emilio Dinelli, tormented by a gang of young rowdies who take him prisoner in his backstreet workshop. (Drama / Fantasy) - 1964

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Directors - Howard Hawks
talkingpictures.uk.description: A look at the life and career of Howard Hawks, the Academy Award-winning director of Only Angels Have Wings, Scarface, Bringing Up Baby and Gentlemen Prefer Blondes. (Biography, Documentary, Entertainment) - 2018

talkingpictures.uk.title: Batman - The Bookworm Turns
talkingpictures.uk.description: The Bookworm, a notorious master of stolen book plots, stages a phoney assassination attempt on Commissioner Gordon. When this fails, Batman and Robin must race to stop The Bookworm from blowing up a bridge. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Crime) - 1966

talkingpictures.uk.title: Batman - While Gotham City Burns
talkingpictures.uk.description: The Bookworm stages a raid on Wayne Manor to steal a rare alchemy book and then plans to dispatch the caped crusader once and for all. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Crime) - 1966

talkingpictures.uk.title: Sherlock Holmes - The Case of the Unlucky Gambler
talkingpictures.uk.description: A boy wants to find his missing father. (Mystery) - 1955

talkingpictures.uk.title: A Touch of the Sun (1958)
talkingpictures.uk.description: William Darling is a hotel porter who inherits a large legacy and finds that he owns the hotel he works in. (Comedy) - 1958

talkingpictures.uk.title: Part-Time Wife (1961)
talkingpictures.uk.description: A husband "loans" his wife to a friend who needs to make a good impression. (Comedy) - 1961

talkingpictures.uk.title: Bad Sister (1931)
talkingpictures.uk.description: Marianne falls in love with con man Valentine who uses their relationship to get her father's endorsement on a money-raising scheme. (Drama) - 1931

talkingpictures.uk.title: Doctor in Trouble (1970)
talkingpictures.uk.description: An amorous doctor pursuing fresh romantic prey inadvertently becomes a stowaway aboard an ocean cruiser. (Comedy) - 1970

talkingpictures.uk.title: Sugar
talkingpictures.uk.description: The restored & infamous 'Marigold sweet shop', that was destroyed during the war, reminds people of the simple pleasures had by those in the times of war and rationing. (Documentary, Special) - 1953

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Buccaneers - Mistress Higgins' Treasure
talkingpictures.uk.description: Captain Tempest is smuggling a load of farm tools to a group of desperate farmers when he encounters a strange woman at sea. (Action, Adventure, Drama) - 1957

talkingpictures.uk.title: Time Lock (1957)
talkingpictures.uk.description: Modest in scale only, this gripping rescue drama reeks of sweat-soaked claustrophobia and suspense. Peter Dawson heads a team of experts, doctors and welders racing against the clock to save a six-year-old boy who's been trapped in a seemingly impregnable bank vault. (Thriller) - 1957

talkingpictures.uk.title: Look At Life - Tulip Town
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1961. A look into 'Spalding', which is known as Britain's Tulip Town. Showing Tulip farming in Spalding, Lincolnshire and scenes of the Flower Parade. (Documentary, Community, History, Special) - 1961

talkingpictures.uk.title: Odd Man Out (1947)
talkingpictures.uk.description: A wounded fugitive's dark odyssey through the streets of Belfast. Following a `fundraising' robbery which goes horribly wrong, the badly injured, abandoned, and increasingly delirious IRA leader wanders the city in search of an escape route from the British authorities. (Thriller) - 1947

talkingpictures.uk.title: Puzzle Corner No. 22
talkingpictures.uk.description: Charming question time set around the 1950s, with incredible shots of London Airport, Coventry, the Coast while viewers solve problems. Such as how many grooves on a 12 inch LP? When will the B.O.A.C plane reach New York. (Documentary, Entertainment, Special) - 1950

talkingpictures.uk.title: Rooms - Monica Part 1
talkingpictures.uk.description: Monica Webster battles with her inner self at the bedsit, until she receives a welcomed visitor. (Drama, Entertainment) - 1974

talkingpictures.uk.title: Rooms - Monica Part 2
talkingpictures.uk.description: Monica faces the toughest battle between love and vanity, as her relationship is constantly interrogated. (Drama, Entertainment) - 1974

talkingpictures.uk.title: Out of Town - Long Distance Ride
talkingpictures.uk.description: Jack explains the intricacies of the universal troop saddle and, on the longest day of the year, he watches endurance riding in the New Forest. (Documentary, Community, Nature) - 1986

talkingpictures.uk.title: Dick Turpin - The Upright Man
talkingpictures.uk.description: Several members of 'The Brotherhood' have fallen into the hands of the law and been hanged. Suspecting betrayal, Dick decides to visit the Brotherhood's leader, Tyson Sarney, known as the 'Upright Man'. (Action, Adventure, Biography) - 1979

talkingpictures.uk.title: Van der Valk - A Season for Love
talkingpictures.uk.description: A rich, middle-aged American flies into Amsterdam to meet her young lover, only to learn that he has disappeared. (Crime drama, Mystery) - 1973

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Lost World
talkingpictures.uk.description: Professor Challenger leads a party of explorers from the smog of Edwardian London to South America in search of a mythical plateau rumoured to be inhabited by dinosaurs. Based on the tale by Sir Arthur Conan Doyle.

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Lost World
talkingpictures.uk.description: Professor Challenger leads a party of explorers from the smog of Edwardian London to South America in search of a mythical plateau rumoured to be inhabited by dinosaurs. Based on the tale by Sir Arthur Conan Doyle.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Confessions of a Driving Instructor (1977)
talkingpictures.uk.description: When a young man sets up a driving school, he finds himself more interested in the charms of his female pupils than actually instructing them. (Comedy) - 1977

talkingpictures.uk.title: To Dorothy a Son (1954)
talkingpictures.uk.description: (Comedy) - 1954

talkingpictures.uk.title: Look at Life - Amphibian
talkingpictures.uk.description: A look at the vehicle designed to assist war-time invasion called DUKWS and other amphibious military craft. (Documentary, Community, History) - 1962

talkingpictures.uk.title: Stagecoach West - The Guardian Angels
talkingpictures.uk.description: Four pathetic and socially useless passengers face savage death and torture. (Western) - 1961

talkingpictures.uk.title: Batman - Death in Slow Motion
talkingpictures.uk.description: The Riddler and his felonious filmmaking cronies interrupt a silent film festival dressed up as Charlie Chaplin and The Keystone Cops to steal the box-office receipts. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Crime) - 1966

talkingpictures.uk.title: Batman - The Riddler's False Notion
talkingpictures.uk.description: A trail of riddles leads Batman to rescue Robin, who is being used as a stuntman in The Riddler's dangerous films. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Crime) - 1966

talkingpictures.uk.title: Sherlock Holmes - The Case of the Tyrant's Daughter
talkingpictures.uk.description: A television adaptation of some of Sir Arthur Conan Doyle's popular stories. (Mystery) - 1955

talkingpictures.uk.title: Doublecross (1956)
talkingpictures.uk.description: A Cornish fisherman, Albert Pascoe, is paid by two men and a woman to take them over to France by trawler, unaware that they have stolen top secret documents. (Drama) - 1956

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Secret Six (1931)
talkingpictures.uk.description: Reporters, vigilantes, a moll and a crooked lawyer bring down a bootlegger. (Crime drama) - 1931

talkingpictures.uk.title: Man From Tangier (1957)
talkingpictures.uk.description: A stuntman is framed for murder by an undercover organisation that sells counterfeit passports to unfortunate refugees. (Crime drama) - 1957

talkingpictures.uk.title: Appointment With Venus (1952)
talkingpictures.uk.description: During WW2, British Major Valentine Moreland is tasked with rescuing a prized pedigree cow from the German-occupied Channel Island of Armorel. (Comedy / Comedy drama) - 1952

talkingpictures.uk.title: Four Star Playhouse - The Stacked Deck
talkingpictures.uk.description: Fresh out of prison, blackmailer Gus Anderson intends to use Willie's casino to launder his victims' money. To insure his cooperation, Gus' thugs hold one of Willie's waiters hostage. (Drama, Anthology) - 1956

talkingpictures.uk.title: Spotlight on the Stars: Margaret Lockwood
talkingpictures.uk.description: Let's turn back the spotlight with Margaret Lockwood as she presents some of the pictures and personalities who are up to be voted for in the 1948 National Film Awards.

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Duchess of Duke Street - No Lawyers, No Letters
talkingpictures.uk.description: Louisa learns that her landlords would like to terminate her lease and are looking for a breach of it on her part. (Historical drama, Romance) - 1976

talkingpictures.uk.title: Whistle Down the Wind (1962)
talkingpictures.uk.description: A murderer on the run takes refuge in a barn on a lonely Lancashire farm and inadvertently leads the farmer's three children to believe that he is Jesus Christ. (Drama) - 1962

talkingpictures.uk.title: Look at Life - Turning Blades
talkingpictures.uk.description: A look at the importance of the helicopter and its uses, both civil and military but also its failure to become a passenger carrier. (Documentary, Community, History) - 1962

talkingpictures.uk.title: Julius Hagen Season - Week 9: Julius Hagen Intro: A Fire Has Been Arranged
A Fire Has Been Arranged (1935)
talkingpictures.uk.description: Two robbers hide their loot before spending 10 years in jail, but upon release they realise things have changed quite a bit in 10 years. (Comedy / Crime drama) - 1935

talkingpictures.uk.title: Julius Hagen Season - Week 9: Julius Hagen Outro: A Fire Has Been Arranged
talkingpictures.uk.description: Tune in to find out which brilliant Julius Hagen film will be shown next week.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Weir's Way - Glen Affric
talkingpictures.uk.description: Equipped with walking boots and bobbly hat, Tom explores the delights of Glen Affric. (Entertainment, Travel) - 2014

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Brothers - The Race
talkingpictures.uk.description: The Race. 1974. Stars Jennifer Wilson, Richard Easton, John Rolfe. The board is divided about sponsorship of David's race. Meanwhile, Martin questions Brian about Jennifer's relationship with Ted. (Drama) - 1974

talkingpictures.uk.title: Saber of London - Fast Cars and Girls
talkingpictures.uk.description: One-armed detective Mark Saber, an Englishman working with the New York Police Department, along with his assistant, Sergeant Tim Moloney, tracks down criminals by his brilliant use of deduction as well as regular police methods. (Drama, Crime)

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Wheeltappers and Shunters Social Club
talkingpictures.uk.description: Tony Christie sings 'Amarillo' and 'Old Man River'. Francis Yip sings 'Make My Life a Bit Brighter'. Terri Rogers, Alan Randall and Eddie Flanagan also star. (Comedy, Music) - 1975

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Undertaker (2023)
talkingpictures.uk.description: An undertaker makes the wrong choice at a moral crossroads as he is made to dispose of the victims of a gangster's power grab. (Thriller) - 2023

talkingpictures.uk.title: Bad Blood (1982)
talkingpictures.uk.description: Set in WW2 and based on a true story of the New Zealand farmer who refuses to hand in his firearms and the siege that follows. (Drama documentary / Drama / Thriller) - 1982

together.uk.title: Coffy (1973)
together.uk.description: A woman poses as a prostitute and seeks revenge on those who got her sister hopelessly addicted to drugs. Armed with a shotgun, she hits the streets in search of those responsible. (Drama) - 1973

together.uk.title: Edwardian Farm
together.uk.description: It's July and time to bring in the cherry harvest with the help of Dartmoor pony Laddy. Historian Ruth Goodman tries her hand at salmon netting, while archaeologists Alex Langlands and Peter Ginn try to save their potato crop from being destroyed by blight. Alex goes to an Edwardian school room to recruit a traditional rural source of cheap labour: children. Ruth learns how to make a bathing suit from wool. (Documentary, History) - 2011

together.uk.title: Clive Myrie's Italian Roadtrip - Naples
together.uk.description: Staying in what was one of Naples' poorest neighbourhoods, in a hotel that's also an art gallery, Clive discovers how this always-colourful city is changing for the better. As a big fan of opera, Clive is also excited to join the cast of the Teatro San Carlo opera house in the run up to their opening night, and while in the costume department, he just can't resist trying a few things on.

together.uk.title: Flipping Profit - Glastonbury
together.uk.description: Antiques auctioneer Charles Hanson, top trader Linda Lambert and trendy upcycler Zoe Pocock head to Glastonbury to find some bargains they can turn into profit. The three experts will compete by unearthing the best that Glastonbury has to offer.

together.uk.title: Cruise TV with LoveitBookit
together.uk.description: Your one-stop-shop for all things cruise; bringing you the hottest destinations, ground-breaking ships and the latest deals! Call 0800 090 3393 or visit us at www.loveitbookit.com/tv.

together.uk.title: Love Your Garden - The Simkiss Family
together.uk.description: Alan Titchmarsh and team visit Hull to transform the garden of Macmillan nurse Maggie Simkiss, who cares for patients at the end of their lives, treating their emotional wellbeing as well as their medical needs. Even if someone has been diagnosed with just hours to live, Maggie says there is a great deal she can do to make their final hours worthwhile and happy. Outside work she is equally devoted to charities and also looks after her grandchildren, so her garden has been neglected.

together.uk.title: Edwardian Farm
together.uk.description: August brings the climax of the farming year - and the end of 12 months on the Edwardian Farm for the team. Their last challenge is to harvest their oat crop, but everything depends on the weather. To celebrate the end of harvest, the whole town enjoys a grand fete sporting new innovations such as the electric light bulb, the latest threshing machines, the petrol-powered Lister engine and a genuine flying machine. (Documentary, History) - 2011

together.uk.title: Clive Myrie's Italian Roadtrip - Lazio
together.uk.description: Clive heads north from Lazio's capital, Rome, to the dramatic valleys of Italy's badlands, out of which rise the fairy-tale citadel of Civita di Bagnoregio - Lazio's ghost town. Meeting one of the 20 remaining residents, Clive finds out what it's like to be outnumbered by a million annual visitors, and he explores the ancient tunnels beneath the town to discover why it's slowly crumbling to dust.

together.uk.title: The Good Karma Hospital
together.uk.description: As Holi festival fever hits the hospital, an abandoned baby strikes a chord with Ruby. Lydia is reacquainted with an ageing ex-pat artist. (Drama, Medical, Miniseries) - 2017

together.uk.title: Hamish Macbeth - The Big Freeze
together.uk.description: An apparent break-in at the home of the local laird attracts the attention of Hamish's heavy-handed superiors in Inverness. As the police swarm to Lochdubh, Hamish is preoccupied by the strange behaviour of his friend TV John. (Comedy drama, Crime) - 1995

together.uk.title: Yorkshire By The Sea
together.uk.description: In Scarborough, we hit the waves with an accessible surfing group, and in Robin Hood's Bay, we follow the ambitious couple launching their first wine from their vineyard. (Documentary, Environment, Nature)

together.uk.title: Our Dream Farm with Matt Baker
together.uk.description: The wannabe-tenants demonstrate their heads for business at Hexham Farmers' Market, but as lambing starts on the farm, tensions mount. Who will Giles and Sally be sending home.

(Documentary, History) - 2011

cinemax.us.title: The Blair Witch Project
cinemax.us.description: A filmmaking crew (Heather Donahue, Michael C. Williams, Joshua Leonard) hikes into Maryland's Black Hills Forest seeking clues about a legendary witch. - 1999

cinemax.us.title: Blair Witch
cinemax.us.description: A group of friends (James Allen McCune, Callie Hernandez, Corbin Reid) and their two guides encounter the legendary Blair Witch while exploring the Black Hills Forest in Maryland. - 2016

cinemax.us.title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
cinemax.us.description: When a townie takes collegians on an overnight tour in Burkittsville, Md., they awake to chaos and have no memory of sleeping. - 2000

cinemax.us.title: My Soul to Take
cinemax.us.description: A teen (Max Thieriot) must figure a way to save his friends from a presumed-dead serial killer who has returned to finish the job he started 16 years earlier. - 2010

cinemax.us.title: Black Butterfly
cinemax.us.description: A down-on-his luck screenwriter picks up a drifter and offers him a place to stay, not knowing that soon he'll become a prisoner, forced to write for a deranged stranger. - 2017

cinemax.us.title: A Clockwork Orange
cinemax.us.description: Young Alex (Malcolm McDowell) and his droogs commit barbaric acts in a near-future, dehumanizing society. - 1971

cinemax.us.title: Extraction
cinemax.us.description: A government analyst (Kellan Lutz) launches his own rescue mission when terrorists kidnap his father (Bruce Willis), a retired CIA operative. - 2015

cinemax.us.title: Despicable Me
cinemax.us.description: As he tries to execute a fiendish plot to steal the moon, a supervillain meets his match in three little orphan girls who want to make him their dad. - 2010

cinemax.us.title: Megan Leavey
cinemax.us.description: Young Marine Cpl. Megan Leavey starts to identify with Rex, a particularly aggressive combat dog that she trains. Together, they complete more than 100 missions until an improvised explosive device injures both, putting their fates in jeopardy. - 2017

cinemax.us.title: Our Kind of Traitor
cinemax.us.description: A money launderer (Stellan Skarsgard) for Russian gangsters asks a couple vacationing in Marrakech, Morocco, to deliver incriminating evidence to an MI6 agent (Damian Lewis). - 2016

cinemax.us.title: Catfish
cinemax.us.description: An unexpected odyssey rolls out when a filmmaker's brother begins receiving unusually advanced paintings from a girl, supposedly 8 years old. - 2010

cinemax.us.title: The Greatest Showman
cinemax.us.description: P.T. Barnum indulges his limitless imagination to create the Barnum & Bailey circus in the 1800s. Featuring musical numbers, exotic performers and daring feats, the mesmerizing spectacle takes the world by storm to become the greatest show on Earth. - 2017

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's 11
cinemax.us.description: Veterans of the 82nd Airborne Division devise an elaborate plot to simultaneously rob five casinos on New Year's Eve. - 1960

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
cinemax.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean organizes a gang to steal $150 million from three Las Vegas casinos in a single heist. - 2001

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's Twelve
cinemax.us.description: To pay back casino boss Terry Benedict, Danny Ocean and his team of criminals plan an elaborate heist in Europe. - 2004

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
cinemax.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2007

cinemax.us.title: Pacific Rim Uprising
cinemax.us.description: Jake Pentecost is a once-promising Jaeger pilot whose legendary father gave his life to secure humanity's victory against the monstrous Kaiju. Jake has since abandoned his training only to become caught up in a criminal underworld. But when an even more unstoppable threat is unleashed to tear through cities and bring the world to its knees, Jake is given one last chance by his estranged sister, Mako Mori, to live up to his father's legacy. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: Meg 2: The Trench
cinemax.us.description: Jonas Taylor leads a research team on an exploratory dive into the deepest depths of the ocean. Their voyage spirals into chaos when a malevolent mining operation threatens their mission and forces them into a high-stakes battle for survival. Pitted against colossal, prehistoric sharks and relentless environmental plunderers, they must outrun, outsmart and outswim their merciless predators. (Science fiction, Thriller, Action, Adventure) - 2023

cinemax.us.title: Open Water
cinemax.us.description: Daniel (Daniel Travis) and Susan (Blanchard Ryan) embark on a tropical vacation with their scuba-diving certifications in tow. During a group dive, the two separate themselves from the others to dive a little deeper. An incorrect head-count suggests the entire group has returned, so the boat departs. When the pair surfaces, they make out a vessel in the distance, but it does not immediately set in that they have been left behind. With sharks lurking beneath, their survival chances grow smaller. (Thriller, Adventure, Drama, Horror) - 2003

cinemax.us.title: The Predator
cinemax.us.description: From the outer reaches of space to the small-town streets of suburbia, the hunt comes home. The universe's most lethal hunters are stronger, smarter and deadlier than ever before, having genetically upgraded themselves with DNA from other species. When a boy accidentally triggers their return to Earth, only a ragtag crew of ex-soldiers and an evolutionary biologist can prevent the end of the human race. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Horror) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: Wonka
cinemax.us.description: Armed with nothing but a hatful of dreams, young chocolatier Willy Wonka manages to change the world, one delectable bite at a time. (Family, Musical comedy, Fantasy) - 2023

cinemax.us.title: Take the Lead
cinemax.us.description: When internationally renowned dancer Pierre Dulaine takes a teaching job in a New York City public school, he meets ridicule from the street-wise students, who scoff at the notion of ballroom dancing. Far from being discouraged, he melds their hip-hop moves with his classical style, helping them create a dance form and, in the process, becoming their mentor. (Musical, Drama) - 2006

cinemax.us.title: Dumb Money
cinemax.us.description: Everyday people flip the script on Wall Street and get rich by turning GameStop into one of the world's hottest companies. In the middle of everything is Keith Gill, a regular guy who starts it all by sinking his life savings into the stock. When his social media posts start blowing up, so does his life and the lives of everyone following him. As a stock tip becomes a movement, everyone gets wealthy -- until the billionaires fight back and both sides find their worlds turned upside down. (Comedy drama, Biography, Docudrama) - 2023

cinemax.us.title: William Shakespeare's Romeo & Juliet
cinemax.us.description: Baz Luhrmann helped adapt this classic Shakespearean romantic tragedy for the screen, updating the setting to a post-modern city named Verona Beach. In this version, the Capulets and the Montagues are two rival gangs. Juliet is attending a costume ball thrown by her parents. Her father Fulgencio Capulet has arranged her marriage to the boorish Paris as part of a strategic investment plan. Romeo attends the masked ball and he and Juliet fall in love. (Romance, Drama) - 1996

cinemax.us.title: The Sessions
cinemax.us.description: Though a childhood bout with polio left him dependent on an iron lung, Mark O'Brien (John Hawkes) maintains a career as a journalist and poet. A writing assignment dealing with sex and the disabled piques Mark's curiosity, and he decides to investigate the possibility of experiencing sex himself. When his overtures toward a caregiver (Annika Marks) scare her away, he books an appointment with sex surrogate Cheryl Cohen Green (Helen Hunt) to lose his virginity. (Comedy drama, Biography) - 2012

cinemax.us.title: Us
cinemax.us.description: Accompanied by her husband, son and daughter, Adelaide Wilson returns to the beachfront home where she grew up as a child. Haunted by a traumatic experience from the past, Adelaide grows increasingly concerned that something bad is going to happen. Her worst fears soon become a reality when four masked strangers descend upon the house, forcing the Wilsons into a fight for survival. When the masks come off, the family is horrified to learn that each attacker takes the appearance of one of them. (Horror, Thriller) - 2019

cinemax.us.title: The Adjustment Bureau
cinemax.us.description: Just as he is on the brink of winning a Senate seat, politician David Norris meets a ballerina named Elise Sellas. Though David is instantly smitten, mysterious men conspire to keep him away from the beautiful dancer. David learns that he is facing the powerful agents of Fate itself, and glimpsing the future laid out for him, must either accept a predetermined path that does not include Elise or else defy Fate to be with her. (Thriller, Romance, Science fiction, Crime drama) - 2011

cinemax.us.title: 3 Days to Kill
cinemax.us.description: Facing a terminal disease, spy Ethan Renner (Kevin Costner) has decided to give up his dangerous, high-stakes life in order to rebuild his relationship with his estranged wife and daughter (Hailee Steinfeld), whom he previously pushed away to keep them out of harm's way. However, in exchange for a potentially lifesaving drug, he must complete one final mission: apprehend one of the world's most ruthless terrorists while looking after his teenage offspring in her mother's absence. (Action, Thriller, Adventure) - 2014

cinemaxaction.us.title: Enter Nowhere
cinemaxaction.us.description: Three strangers arrive one at a time in a remote cabin, and learn they have been brought together for a reason. (Drama, Horror, Movie, Mystery, Thriller) - 2011-10-22

cinemaxaction.us.description: Krypto the Super-Dog and Superman are inseparable best friends, sharing the same superpowers and fighting crime side by side in Metropolis. However, when the Man of Steel and the rest of the Justice League are kidnapped, Krypto must convince a ragtag group of animals to master their own newfound powers for a rescue mission. (Action, Adventure, Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2022-07-29

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla Raids Again
cinemaxaction.us.description: Prehistoric monsters Godzilla and Anguirus battle it out in Osaka, Japan. (Movie, Science fiction) - 1955-04-24

cinemaxaction.us.title: Batman
cinemaxaction.us.description: Having witnessed his parents' brutal murder as a child, millionaire philanthropist Bruce Wayne (Michael Keaton) fights crime in Gotham City disguised as Batman, a costumed hero who strikes fear into the hearts of villains. But when a deformed madman who calls himself "The Joker" (Jack Nicholson) seizes control of Gotham's criminal underworld, Batman must face his most ruthless nemesis ever while protecting both his identity and his love interest, reporter Vicki Vale (Kim Basinger). (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie) - 1989-06-23

cinemaxaction.us.title: Batman Returns
cinemaxaction.us.description: The monstrous Penguin (Danny DeVito), who lives in the sewers beneath Gotham, joins up with wicked shock-headed businessman Max Shreck (Christopher Walken) to topple the Batman (Michael Keaton) once and for all. But when Shreck's timid assistant, Selina Kyle (Michelle Pfeiffer), finds out, and Shreck tries to kill her, she is transformed into the sexy Catwoman. She teams up with the Penguin and Shreck to destroy Batman, but sparks fly unexpectedly when she confronts the caped crusader. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie) - 1992-06-19

cinemaxaction.us.title: Batman Forever
cinemaxaction.us.description: Batman (Val Kilmer) faces off against two foes: the schizophrenic, horribly scarred former District Attorney Harvey Dent, aka Two-Face (Tommy Lee Jones), and the Riddler (Jim Carrey), a disgruntled ex-Wayne Enterprises inventor seeking revenge against his former employer by unleashing his brain-sucking weapon on Gotham City's residents. As the caped crusader also deals with tortured memories of his parents' murder, he has a new romance, with psychologist Chase Meridian (Nicole Kidman). (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie) - 1995-06-16

cinemaxaction.us.title: Batman & Robin
cinemaxaction.us.description: This superhero adventure finds Batman (George Clooney) and his partner, Robin (Chris O'Donnell), attempting to the foil the sinister schemes of a deranged set of new villains, most notably the melancholy Mr. Freeze (Arnold Schwarzenegger), who wants to make Gotham into an arctic region, and the sultry Poison Ivy (Uma Thurman), a plant-loving femme fatale. As the Dynamic Duo contends with these bad guys, a third hero, Batgirl (Alicia Silverstone), joins the ranks of the city's crime-fighters. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie) - 1997-06-20

cinemaxaction.us.title: Joker
cinemaxaction.us.description: Forever alone in a crowd, failed comedian Arthur Fleck seeks connection as he walks the streets of Gotham City. Arthur wears two masks -- the one he paints for his day job as a clown, and the guise he projects in a futile attempt to feel like he's part of the world around him. Isolated, bullied and disregarded by society, Fleck begins a slow descent into madness as he transforms into the criminal mastermind known as the Joker. (Crime drama, Movie) - 2019-08-31

cinemaxaction.us.title: Joker: Folie à Deux
cinemaxaction.us.description: Struggling with his dual identity, failed comedian Arthur Fleck stumbles upon true love while incarcerated at Arkham State Hospital. Awaiting trial for the murder of five people, Fleck soon discovers the music that's always been inside him. (Crime drama, Movie, Musical, Thriller) - 2024-09-04

cinemaxaction.us.title: Birds of Prey (and the Fantabulous Emancipation of One Harley Quinn)
cinemaxaction.us.description: It's open season on Harley Quinn when her explosive breakup with the Joker puts a big fat target on her back. Unprotected and on the run, Quinn faces the wrath of narcissistic crime boss Black Mask, his right-hand man, Victor Zsasz, and every other thug in the city. But things soon even out for Harley when she becomes unexpected allies with three deadly women -- Huntress, Black Canary and Renee Montoya. (Action, Comedy, Movie) - 2020-02-05

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Whistlers

When the pair surfaces, they make out a vessel in the distance, but it does not immediately set in that they have been left behind. With sharks lurking beneath, their survival chances grow smaller. golfpass.us.title: The Golf Fix - Longest Year Ever
golfpass.us.description: Learn unique drills using a cell phone charger, head cover, rope and tree branch that will all increase your club head speed; Devan will also give an in-depth swing analysis on Cameron Young and teach his checkpoints for maximum power.

golfpass.us.title: The Golf Fix - Ball Striking
golfpass.us.description: Devan Bonebrake is fixing the biggest contact faults to make you a better ball striker; learn how a wall can be used to cure fat and thin shots plus Devan's best drill for preventing the shanks.

golfpass.us.title: The Golf Fix - Better Wedge Play
golfpass.us.description: Devan Bonebrake is teaching how to stick your wedges and make more birdies; learn the biggest swing keys that make Justin Thomas one of the best wedge players in the world.

golfpass.us.title: The Golf Fix - Path to Greatness
golfpass.us.description: Devan Bonebrake is putting you on a path to lower scores by improving your swing path; learn setup adjustments, swing keys and creative drills for hitting draws and fades on command.

golfpass.us.title: The Golf Fix - Short Game Faults
golfpass.us.description: Learn how cross-handed chipping helped Matthew Fitzpatrick win the U.S. Open, keys to spinning your wedges like Max Homa and the reason John Daly practices one-arm pitch shots.

golfpass.us.title: The Golf Fix - Early Extension
golfpass.us.description: Learn creative drills to train a better downswing and find out how Michael Jackson's moonwalk will improve your impact; Devan will also reveal a tip for the transition used by Viktor Hovland.

golfpass.us.title: The Golf Fix - Master Your Angles
golfpass.us.description: Devan Bonebrake will reveal the most important swing angles and teach you how to achieve those positions; learn Devan's favorite drills for ideal angles in the backswing, downswing, at impact and in the finish.

golfpass.us.title: The Golf Fix - Ground Forces
golfpass.us.description: Devan Bonebrake is teaching how to use ground forces to maximize your power; learn how a tennis ball, yoga block, kettlebell and exercise band can be used to train for more distance.

golfpass.us.title: The Golf Fix - Lead vs. Trail
golfpass.us.description: Devan Bonebrake teaches how to coordinate the lead and trail side body parts to become a better ball striker.

golfpass.us.title: The Golf Fix - Fatal Fallacy
golfpass.us.description: Learn vital correct information and creative drills to improve grip pressure, footwork, trail arm in the takeaway and head movement throughout the swing.

golfpass.us.title: The Golf Fix - Putting
golfpass.us.description: Learn how to build a practice station for improving start line, an easy guide to green reading and tips for better speed control used by 2023 Masters Champion Jon Rahm.

golfpass.us.title: The Golf Fix - Sequence
golfpass.us.description: Learn a Ben Hogan tip for improving a backswing, how an alignment stick can cure a transition faults and a creative drill using maracas to shake up a downswing sequence.

golfpass.us.title: The Golf Fix - Bunker Play
golfpass.us.description: Devan Bonebrake covers the biggest keys and teaches his favorite drills for getting up and down from greenside bunkers.

golfpass.us.title: The Golf Fix - Go-To Shot
golfpass.us.description: Devan Bonebrake teaches how to develop a go-to shot that will help to play under pressure like a Major Champion; learn how to hit power fades like Jon Rahm, high draws like Rory McIlroy and low stingers like Tiger Woods.

golfpass.us.title: The Golf Fix - Around the Green
golfpass.us.description: Learn how a water bottle will help to stop scooping pitch shots, how a slip and slide will help on downhill lies and how a fairway wood will help players scramble like Tiger Woods.

golfpass.us.title: The Golf Fix - Stop the Slice
golfpass.us.description: Devan Bonebrake teaches setup changes, swing adjustments and creative drills to stop a slice; learn how a sleeping bag, starter pistol, towel and wall can all be used to turn a slice into a powerful draw.

golfpass.us.title: The Golf Fix - Muscle Training
golfpass.us.description: Learn how to improve upper body mobility to prevent coming over the top, increase lower body stability to stop swaying and build full body strength to maximize distance.

golfpass.us.title: The Golf Fix - Accuracy
golfpass.us.description: Learn how petting a dog can improve a swing path and how giving a high five will help control a club face.

golfpass.us.title: The Golf Fix - Swing Aids
golfpass.us.description: Use a lawnmower to improve a backswing, a paper towel roll to train better arm structure and a hammer to hammer the longest drives.

golfpass.us.title: The Golf Fix - Finish Strong
golfpass.us.description: Learn how pickleball can improve shot shaping, how to make the knees kiss for better contact and how to crush the driver like Tony Finau.

golfpass.us.title: Playing Lessons - Cameron Champ
golfpass.us.description: Discover the strategies and techniques that work for them on the big stage and see what you can bring back to your own home course.

golfpass.us.title: Playing Lessons - Danny Willett
golfpass.us.description: Masters champion Danny Willett goes in-depth on accounting for wind, adjusting play from a divot or behind a tree, and going for a par-5 from the fairway as opposed to a fairway bunker.

golfpass.us.title: Playing Lessons - Jennifer Kupcho
golfpass.us.description: 2018 NCAA Individual Champion, Jennifer Kupcho, discusses preparations for the 2019 NCAA Women's Golf Championships and her LPGA debut as a professional.

golfpass.us.title: Playing Lessons - Pat Perez
golfpass.us.description: Multiple-time PGA Tour winner Pat Perez shows how to still score low while not hitting the long ball. Additionally, Perez goes in depth to show how important it is to get your eyes at the right angle to see the line in putting.

golfpass.us.title: Playing Lessons - James Hahn
golfpass.us.description: Multiple time PGA Tour winner James Hahn braves a windy day and displays how his on-course strategy changes when dealing with the elements. Hahn explains the different adjustments to make depending on the direction of the wind.

golfpass.us.title: Playing Lessons - Jaye Marie Green
golfpass.us.description: LPGA standout Jaye Marie Green joins Bones on the course and shares her tips and strategies that have led to her impressive professional career. Lessons include a break-down of her lag putting process, how to hit it high over the trouble, and more.

golfpass.us.title: Build a Better Game - Swing Checkpoints, Part 1
golfpass.us.description: Debbie Doniger is here to go through the checkpoints of the golf swing -- from the setup to the top of the backswing. She's got individualized tips and drills for each position to help golfers play their best golf and own their swing.

golfpass.us.title: Build a Better Game - Swing Checkpoints, Part 2
golfpass.us.description: Debbie Doniger is back to go through the rest of the checkpoints of the swing -- from the transition through impact. Plus, with this newfound knowledge, she'll help put all the checkpoints together to have golfers swinging their best in no time.

golfpass.us.title: Breaking Your Slice With Nathalie Sheehan - Introduction
golfpass.us.description: Nathalie introduces the contributing factors of a slice and identifies the two types of slicers that exist.

golfpass.us.title: Breaking Your Slice With Nathalie Sheehan - Grip & Setup
golfpass.us.description: Nathalie introduces an error that some might be making with a grip to cause a slice; she also explains the differences between a draw setup with a driver and one with the irons.

golfpass.us.title: Build a Better Game - Through the Bag: How a Straw Can Improve Your Putting
golfpass.us.description: Aimee explains a common mistake she sees with amateurs when they're struggling with the putter; she shows how simply using a straw can drastically improve this fault, and help anyone's overall putting.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 17: Open Golf

golfpass.us.description: Martin Hall and Blair O'Neal teach how to chip it close and sink the short putt to help you scramble for scores; how to use your thumbs to control trajectory around the green; a lesson on Zen putting to help you handle the pressure on the greens.

golfpass.us.title: School of Golf - Chapter 25: Make Practice Fun

golfpass.us.description: Competitors must rely on one another to earn safety as team formats rule the challenges. A shaky performance must be overcome to keep the Super Immunity out of play, while an unexpected twist sends players directly to the elimination challenge.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - A Putt for the Win
golfpass.us.description: A distinctive golf course feature becomes the setting for high drama as the players battle for immunity. One competitor's timely use of a mulligan earns safety, setting up an elimination match which comes down to the last putt.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Pawleys Plantation
golfpass.us.description: The remaining competitors take a road trip south on the Grand Strand, where choosing the right opponents could prove lucrative for one player. Accuracy off the tee is tested, and an untimely error threatens to derail one contestant's dream.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Limbo Wall
golfpass.us.description: As the field dwindles, players must negotiate the limbo wall to secure immunity. One competitor commits a costly mental mistake which could lead to disaster. A surprise development brings Super Immunity back into the discussion.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Final Five

nflnetwork.us.description: NFL Network enters the morning show fray with a three-hour live presentation. Each day, "Good Morning Football" brings viewers up-to-the-minute breaking NFL news and local NFL stories on a national platform. The show features a combination of headline-making interviews and a discussion of a wide array of issues in the areas of sports, news and entertainment. By booking celebrity guests and opinionated national and local journalists -- and taking advantage of a close collaboration with all 32 NFL franchises -- "Good Morning Football" breaks out within and well beyond its time period. (Sports talk, Football) - 2016-08-01

With the help of the group Marry a Canadian, John joins forces with another aspiring ex-pat, Chloe (Anna Paquin), for a road trip up north during which they talk politics, life and, eventually, love. (Comedy) - 2007

screenpix.us.title: High Spirits
screenpix.us.description: Irish hotelier Peter Plunkett attempts to fill the chronic vacancies at his castle by launching an advertising campaign that wrongly portrays the property as haunted. Unfortunately, he fails to scare a single American tourist with his hokey and dreadfully unconvincing effects. When two actual ghosts, Mary and Martin, show up to add some authenticity, they end up falling for two guests, Sharon and Jack. (Thriller, Comedy) - 1988

screenpix.us.title: Shadow of Suspicion
screenpix.us.description: A jewelry firm hires private eye James Dale (Peter Cookson) and his partner Everett Northrup (Tim Ryan) to find a valuable necklace after a manager steals it. (Mystery) - 1944

screenpix.us.title: I'll Take Sweden
screenpix.us.description: Widower Bob Holcomb has strong opinions when it comes to what is best for his beautiful teenage daughter, JoJo. When JoJo and her slacker boyfriend start talking marriage, Bob whisks her away on a trip to Sweden to make her forget the relationship. There, Bob discovers that Sweden is a much more sexually liberated country than the U.S., and he reconsiders his plan as he fights to protect his daughter from a charming playboy. (Musical comedy) - 1965

screenpix.us.title: Pumpkin
screenpix.us.description: Carolyn's (Christina Ricci) sorority sisters set their sights on the Sorority of the Year award and coaching challenged athletes is their ticket to the trophy. But when the queen of formals finds herself mentoring Pumpkin (Hank Harris), a disabled athlete, their two worlds collide. (Dark comedy) - 2002

screenpix.us.title: The Charge of the Light Brigade
screenpix.us.description: During the Crimean War between Britain and Russia in the 1850s, a British cavalry division, led by the overbearing Lord Cardigan (Trevor Howard), engages in an infamously reckless strategic debacle against a Russian artillery battery. An inept chain of command and the arrogance of the aristocratic officers nearly destroys the brigade. Interpersonal wars within the unit, including unfaithful wives and a rivalry between Lord Cardigan and Captain Nolan (David Hemmings), heighten the conflict. (Historical drama) - 1968

screenpix.us.title: Kiss Me, Stupid
screenpix.us.description: When popular singer Dino (Dean Martin) stops for gas in a small town near Las Vegas, mechanic Barney (Cliff Osmond) disables his car. Barney, who writes songs with local teacher Orville (Ray Walston), wants Dino to sing some of their compositions. Orville invites Dino over, but sends his wife, Zelda (Felicia Farr), away so Dino can't hit on her. He then hires prostitute Polly (Kim Novak) to play his wife. Meanwhile, Zelda goes to a bar, where she gets drunk and eventually meets a lonely Dino. (Romantic comedy) - 1964

screenpix.us.title: Hannibal Brooks
screenpix.us.description: A British prisoner of war is assigned to take care of an elephant in a zoo. Along with an American and an Austrian he escapes with the elephant and heads for the Swiss border. They use the elephant to gain access across the border. A Polish girl betrays them and aligns herself with the Nazis. (Comedy drama, War) - 1969

screenpix.us.title: No Place Like Home
screenpix.us.description: When an apartment complex goes up in flames, it doesn't just rob Mike Cooper of his home -- it puts him out of his job as building superintendent. Mike and his family move in with his brother Eddie while he looks for employment as an electrician. But, after butting heads with their relatives, the Coopers have to move out. Now living in a homeless shelter, Mike and his wife Zan struggle to survive and keep their children out of harm's way. (Drama) - 1989

screenpix.us.title: The Best Man
screenpix.us.description: Secretary of State William Russell (Henry Fonda) lives by his principles, but is haunted by a recent sexual indiscretion that threatens both his marriage and his career. Senator Joe Cantwell (Cliff Robertson) presents himself as the people's candidate, yet his determination to win at all costs is also his great flaw. These two frontrunners for their party's presidential nomination vie for the support of the outgoing president (Lee Tracy), and resort to mudslinging in a very public contest. (Drama) - 1964

screenpixaction.us.title: Down Three Dark Streets
screenpixaction.us.description: An FBI agent (Broderick Crawford) inherits three unsolved cases from a slain agent, cases which might reveal the killer. - 1954

screenpixaction.us.title: Five Steps to Danger
screenpixaction.us.description: Soviet spies follow a stranded motorist (Sterling Hayden) and the code-carrying woman (Ruth Roman) who gives him a ride. - 1957

screenpixaction.us.title: Nightmare
screenpixaction.us.description: A New Orleans police detective (Edward G. Robinson) helps his brother-in-law, a jazz musician (Kevin McCarthy) haunted by a dream of murder. - 1956

screenpixaction.us.title: Street of Sinners
screenpixaction.us.description: A police rookie (George Montgomery) has trouble after confronting a well-connected bar owner (Nehemiah Persoff) on his first day. - 1957

screenpixaction.us.title: Shield for Murder
screenpixaction.us.description: A police detective (Edmond O'Brien) kills a bookie, robs him and hides the loot at his suburban dream house. - 1954

screenpixaction.us.title: Woman of Straw
screenpixaction.us.description: An old English tycoon (Ralph Richardson) is found dead after his nephew (Sean Connery) hires a gorgeous nurse (Gina Lollobrigida) to lure him into marriage. - 1964

screenpixaction.us.title: Timbuktu
screenpixaction.us.description: An American wheeler-dealer (Victor Mature) woos a colonel's (George Dolenz) wife (Yvonne De Carlo) amid danger at a French Foreign Legion fort. - 1959

screenpixaction.us.title: Night Ambush
screenpixaction.us.description: British officers (Dirk Bogarde, David Oxley) conspire with Greek patriots to kidnap a German commander (Marius Goring) and transport him to Egypt. - 1958

screenpixaction.us.title: The Ceremony
screenpixaction.us.description: A man (Robert Walker) has an affair with his condemned brother's (Laurence Harvey) girlfriend (Sarah Miles) while plotting his escape in Tangier. - 1963

screenpixaction.us.title: Three Came to Kill
screenpixaction.us.description: Assassins take a flight controller's family hostage to force him into revealing the aircraft carrying their quarry. - 1960

screenpixaction.us.title: Kings Go Forth
screenpixaction.us.description: An Army lieutenant (Frank Sinatra) and sergeant (Tony Curtis) become rivals for the daughter (Natalie Wood) of a mixed marriage in 1944 France. - 1958

screenpixaction.us.title: The Purple Plain
screenpixaction.us.description: At the end of World War II in Burma, Canadian Royal Air Force pilot Forrester (Gregory Peck) is a loner whose bravery can't cover a streak of reckless instability. When his actions cause an injury, he is nearly transferred, but Dr. Harris (Bernard Lee) recommends pulling him from duty, due to the emotional trauma he's suffered. Forrester then accompanies Harris to a Christian missionary outpost, where he meets Anna (Win Min Than) and begins to find interest in living again. (Adventure, Action) - 1954

screenpixaction.us.title: Ten Seconds to Hell
screenpixaction.us.description: After the end of World War II, six German soldiers return to Berlin and form a bomb disposal unit. Defusing bombs is extremely risky business, so every week the group contributes to a fund that will go to the last man standing. Only Karl Wirtz and Eric Koertner are left, and their once solid friendship is starting to crack. Adding to the tension is their rivalry over a local woman and one last job that could change everything. (Thriller) - 1959

screenpixaction.us.title: Beachhead
screenpixaction.us.description: During World War II, four Marines land on a Pacific island to execute the rescue of French planter Bouchard (Eduard Franz) and his daughter, Nina (Mary Murphy). With Japanese soldiers hidden throughout the dense jungle landscape, the Marines face a daunting trek to reach their target and must endure even greater danger on the return trip with the two French citizens. In the end, one of the Marines, Burke (Tony Curtis), carries the responsibility of getting everyone to safety. (War, Drama) - 1954

screenpixaction.us.title: The One That Got Away
screenpixaction.us.description: Franz von Werra (Hardy Kruger) is a Luftwaffe pilot by trade, but an escape artist by necessity. When his plane is attacked over England, he initiates his first effort to break out of the POW camp only days after arriving. Transferred to a second, more secure facility, Franz nevertheless manages to tunnel out and very nearly steals an airplane before being recaptured. This time the Allies send him to be imprisoned in Canada, but he steadfastly insists that no cell will hold him. (Adventure, Action) - 1957

screenpixaction.us.title: The Spanish Gardener
screenpixaction.us.description: Harrington Brande (Michael Hordern), a British diplomat who recently broke up with his wife, is stationed in a small coastal town in Spain with his son, Nicholas (Jon Whiteley). Harrington is unreasonably possessive of Nicholas, and becomes jealous when he begins to form a close friendship with Jose (Dirk Bogarde), their gentle gardener. When Harrington decides to frame Jose for a crime to end their relationship, Nicholas becomes enraged and runs away from home. (Drama) - 1957

screenpixaction.us.title: Run for the Sun
screenpixaction.us.description: Katie Connors (Jane Greer), a writer for a tabloid magazine, travels to Mexico to find reclusive novelist Mike Latimer (Richard Widmark). When she uncovers him, the two develop feelings for each other, and Mike offers to fly her back to Mexico City. After their plane crashes in the jungle they are rescued by an Englishman named Browne (Trevor Howard), who seems very hospitable at first but soon reveals a sinister hobby. He is a hunter who preys on "the most dangerous game": man. (Thriller) - 1956

screenpixaction.us.title: Pork Chop Hill
screenpixaction.us.description: Because final peace negotiations are bogged down in political maneuvering, U.S. soldiers, led by Lt. Joe Clemons (Gregory Peck), are forced to assault entrenched Chinese troops. The site of battle is Pork Chop Hill, a daunting, desolate climb that gives the communist forces a clear advantage. Clash after deadly clash wears down the morale and readiness of Clemons' men, and when they ask for backup, command is neither willing to send reinforcements nor authorize a retreat. (War, Drama) - 1959

screenpixaction.us.title: Kings Go Forth
screenpixaction.us.description: During World War II, in a picturesque town on the French Riviera, U.S. Army Lt. Sam Loggins (Frank Sinatra) and Cpl. Britt Harris (Tony Curtis) both fall for the same local girl, the American-born Monique Blair (Natalie Wood). But when the soldiers learn that Monique and her mother (Leora Dana) had moved to France from the United States to escape discrimination against her parents' interracial marriage, each man must examine his own bigotry and prejudices. (War, Drama) - 1958

screenpixaction.us.title: Hell's Belles
screenpixaction.us.description: When biker Dan (Jeremy Slate) wins a motorcycle race, he wants to sell the bike he receives as a prize and use the cash to buy a ranch. But the bike is stolen by Tony (Michael Walker) and finds its way into the hands of Tampa (Adam Roarke), so Dan goes on a quest for revenge. He tracks down Tampa and his gang and uses a variety of tools to neutralize them, all in pursuit of his prized motorcycle. Dan's worried girlfriend, Cathy (Jocelyn Lane), tags along for the violent ride. (Action) - 1969

screenpixaction.us.title: The Wild Angels
screenpixaction.us.description: When Hell's Angels member Loser (Bruce Dern) has his motorcycle swiped, he entreats his gang to help him seek the bike, and revenge. Gang leader Heavenly Blues (Peter Fonda) and his lady, Mike (Nancy Sinatra), succeed in tracking down the thieves, but when a fracas breaks out between the gangs, the cops shoot Loser, putting him in the hospital. The rest of the Angels try to rescue Loser from his sickbed, wreaking havoc in the ward and doing their buddy more harm than good. (Action) - 1966

screenpixvoices.us.description: The love lives of several people intersect after Chloe (Alexa Davalos) moves to an Oregon town and takes a job in a coffee shop. - 2007

screenpixvoices.us.title: Truck Turner
screenpixvoices.us.description: Bounty hunter Mack "Truck" Turner (Isaac Hayes) almost always finds his target, but his latest prize -- a pimp called Gator (Paul Harris) -- is killed while Turner is chasing him. Gator's girl, Dorinda (Nichelle Nichols), vows to avenge his death and offers ownership of her successful call-girl operation to anyone who can knock off Turner. Upscale pimp Harvard Blue (Yaphet Kotto) steps in, upping the ante with professional assassins. Turner, however, isn't going down easily. (Action) - 1974

screenpixvoices.us.title: Odds Against Tomorrow
screenpixvoices.us.description: Disgraced former police officer David Burke (Ed Begley) is looking for a way to make some quick money. When he decides to rob a bank, he calls on mean ex-con Earle Slater (Robert Ryan) and black entertainer Johnny Ingram (Harry Belafonte) to help him pull off the heist. Johnny is reluctant to agree but is forced to reconsider because of his significant gambling debts, while racist Earle balks because of Johnny's involvement. Ultimately, though, they must work together to get the job done. (Crime drama) - 1959

screenpixvoices.us.title: Diary of a Hitman
screenpixvoices.us.description: A veteran hit man, Dekker (Forest Whitaker) is ready to call it quits and leave the profession. Dekker's final job, however, proves to be trickier than expected when the sadistic Zidzyck (Lewis Smith) recruits the assassin to kill his wife, Jain (Sherilyn Fenn), along with the couple's baby. While Dekker has a change of heart and resolves not to shoot Jain and her child, his decision places all their lives in danger, since Zidzyck has dispatched another killer to perform the task. (Crime drama) - 1992

screenpixvoices.us.title: The Organization
screenpixvoices.us.description: When an executive and a night watchman are killed in a San Francisco office building, Lt. Virgil Tibbs is called in to investigate and discovers the watchman was actually killed elsewhere. Soon Tibbs is contacted by urban revolutionaries who confess to kidnapping -- but not killing -- the watchman in a botched attempt to expose a heroin ring operating out of the building. Tibbs believes them, but when his superiors learn of his ties to the group, he's suspended from the force. (Action, Crime drama, Thriller) - 1971

screenpixvoices.us.title: Friday Foster
screenpixvoices.us.description: On assignment from her editor, photographer Friday Foster (Pam Grier) travels to an airport to capture a few shots of the richest black man in the United States (Thalmus Rasulala). But it turns out Foster isn't the only one taking shots as she witnesses -- and photographs -- an assassination attempt on her subject. With definitive evidence in her possession, she also becomes a target of the assassins. Joining a private eye (Yaphet Kotto), Foster sets out to discover the truth behind the attempt. (Crime drama) - 1975

screenpixvoices.us.title: Sheba, Baby
screenpixvoices.us.description: When the loan business of her father, Andy (Rudy Challenger), is trashed by thugs looking to force a sale, Chicago private investigator Sheba Shayne (Pam Grier) travels back to her hometown of Louisville, Ky., to even the score. Together with old flame Brick Williams (Austin Stoker), she attacks the henchmen of local loan shark Pilot (D'Urville Martin), but a retaliation leaves Andy dead. Blind with rage, Sheba vows to take out Pilot's boss, mob kingpin Shark (Dick Merrifield). (Action) - 1975

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Winds of Autumn
screenpixwesterns.us.description: An 11-year-old Quaker boy sets out across the grasslands of 1880s Montana to avenge his family's deaths. - 1976

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Barquero
screenpixwesterns.us.description: A ferryman (Lee Van Cleef) and a mountain man (Forrest Tucker) defend Mexican-border settlers from a black-clad outlaw (Warren Oates) and his gang. - 1970

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Hunting Party
screenpixwesterns.us.description: A cattle baron (Gene Hackman) with a long-range rifle hunts the outlaw (Oliver Reed) who has kidnapped his wife (Candice Bergen). - 1971

screenpixwesterns.us.title: The Scalphunters
screenpixwesterns.us.description: A fur trader (Burt Lancaster) and a cultured slave (Ossie Davis) have run-ins with Indians and marauders. - 1968

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Blood Red
screenpixwesterns.us.description: A Sicilian winegrower's son falls in love during a war against a railroad magnate in the 1800s California. - 1989

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Gun Street
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Frank Bogan (Warren Kemmerling), a violent criminal sentenced to the death penalty, escapes from prison and vows revenge against those he blames for his capture. Local sheriff Chuck Morton (James Brown) is tasked with warning Bogan's likely victims. - 1961

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Bat Masterson - The Fatal Garment
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Wyatt Earp hires Bat as a bodyguard at his casino in El Paso; robbers distract Bat with an expensive shirt as they make off with $13,000 of Earp's money.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Bat Masterson - Jeopardy at Jackson Hole
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Bat goes to Jackson Hole, Wyo., to investigate the murder of an old friend at the request of his daughter; the family's freight business faces bankruptcy due to the unsolved murders of its drivers.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Tombstone Territory - Gun Hostage
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Hollister tracks down an escaped killer who seeks refuge at a ranch near Tombstone.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Tombstone Territory - Warrant for Death
screenpixwesterns.us.description: Hollister finds a fellow stage passenger to be unusually knowledgeable about a killer Hollister is hunting.

screenpixwesterns.us.title: Gunfighters of Abilene

Jilted by Dan, Alex becomes unstable, her behavior escalating from aggressive pursuit to obsessive stalking. showtimeshowcase.us.title: Not Without Hope

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Run & Gun

showtimeshowcase.us.title: The Foreigner

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Reindeer Games

(Crime drama, Thriller, Action) - 2000

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Domestic Disturbance

showtimeshowcase.us.title: The Last Stop in Yuma County

showtimeshowcase.us.title: Homestead

In a string of traumatic events Sammy is torn between helping her brother and her maternal instinct to protect her son from getting hurt. (Drama) - 2000

With the help of his new friend, Willard Hewitt (Christopher Penn), and defiant teen Ariel Moore (Lori Singer), he might loosen up this conservative town. But Ariel's influential father, Reverend Shaw Moore (John Lithgow), stands in the way. (Drama, Music, Romance, Comedy) - 1984

showtimewomen.us.title: Don Jon

showtimewomen.us.title: Blue Valentine

However, his lack of ambition and her retreat into self-absorption cause potentially irreversible cracks in their marriage. (Drama, Romance) - 2010

showtimewomen.us.title: Vanilla Sky

(Thriller, Drama, Romance, Science fiction, Mystery) - 2001

showtimewomen.us.title: Proof

(Drama) - 2005

(Thriller, Action, Drama, Mystery) - 2005

showtimewomen.us.title: Molly's Game

Her players included Hollywood royalty, sports stars, business titans and finally, unbeknown to her, the Russian mob. Her only ally was her criminal defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learned there was much more to Molly than the tabloids led people to believe. (Biography, Drama) - 2017

To accomplish his mission, Dave devises a foolproof plan: He packs a fake family into a huge RV and heads south of the border for a wild weekend that is sure to end with a bang. (Comedy, Action, Crime drama) - 2013

showtimewomen.us.title: Queen Bees

His past is revealed through flashbacks involving a married Englishwoman (Kristin Scott Thomas) and his work mapping the African landscape. Hana learns to heal her own scars as she helps the dying man. (Romance, War, Historical drama) - 1996

"After Innocence" brings to light flaws in the criminal justice system and the need for reform. (Documentary) - 2005

shoxbetwest.us.title: Hitsville: The Making of Motown

Frantz (Dylan McDermott) and composed of both seasoned troops and new recruits, attempts to take a hill during the Vietnam War. Vance). (War, Historical drama, Action, Thriller, Docudrama) - 1987

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Sky Cinema Preview

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Karate Kid: Legends

In a world where everyone needs a heart song to attract a soul mate, Mumble feels he doesn't belong there. Our hero Mumble is the worst singer in the world, but he can tap dance brilliantly.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Happy Feet Two
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Mumble's son Erik hasn't yet found his talents, and he goes with his friends to Adélie-land which is ruled by a penguin who can fly. When Erik returns to Emperor-land and finds them trapped under big walls of ice. Will Erik be able to save his family and friends before it is too late?

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Peter Rabbit
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Peter Rabbit and his three sisters -- Flopsy, Mopsy and Cotton-Tail -- enjoy spending their days in Mr. McGregor's vegetable garden. When one of McGregor's relatives suddenly moves in, he's less than thrilled to discover a family of rabbits in his new home. A battle of wills soon breaks out as the new owner hatches scheme after scheme to get rid of Peter -- a resourceful rabbit who proves to be a worthy and wily opponent.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Secret Life of Pets
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A domesticated terrier and his unruly canine pal encounter a rebellious bunny and his gang of abandoned pets.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Secret Life of Pets 2
skycinemafamily.uk.description: The film explores the bonds between pets and the families that love them, and answers the question: What are your pets doing when you’re not at home?

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Wonder Park

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Antz

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks

There, they buddy up with failing songwriter Dave, who realises the talented critters have got the potential for big musical success. When the chipmunks are signed by big-shot producer Ian, will fame and fortune go to their heads?

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Witches

Brought up on his kindly grandmother's scary stories about witches, he stumbles on a real coven while on holiday. Overhearing their plans to capture all the children in Britain, he sets out to stop them, remaining undeterred throughout - even when he has been turned into a mouse.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: A Dog's Purpose

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Jack the Giant Slayer

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Yogi Bear

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Fantastic Mr. Fox

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Open Season
