skycinemafamily.uk.title: Trolls
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Poppy, the optimistic leader of the trolls, and Branch, her polar opposite, embark on an adventure that takes them far beyond the only world they've ever known.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Tafiti: Across the Desert
skycinemafamily.uk.description: When his grandfather gets bitten by a snake, a young meerkat embarks on an adventure across the desert to find the magical flower that can cure him.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Boss Baby
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A new baby's arrival impacts a family, told from the point of view of a delightfully unreliable narrator, a wildly imaginative Seven-year-old named Tim. The most unusual Boss Baby arrives at Tim's home in a taxi, wearing a suit and carrying a briefcase. The instant sibling rivalry must soon be put aside when Tim discovers that Boss Baby is actually a spy on a secret mission, and only he can help thwart a dastardly plot that involves an epic battle between puppies and babies.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Squeakquel
skycinemafamily.uk.description: The loveable rodents Alvin, Simon and Theodore must enrol in school when their human friend Dave is hospitalised. In addition to bearing the unwelcome attention of bullies, they also discover that the school's music department is threatened by financial cuts. Their attempts to save it are hampered by a group of female chipmunks, the Chipettes, who are managed by the Chipmunks' sworn enemy, Ian.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Annie
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Daddy Warbucks opens his estate to a spunky orphan in this adaptation of the popular comic strip and hit Broadway show.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Look Who's Talking
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A pregnant woman was deserted by her partner. When she goes into labour, a friendly taxi driver rushes her to hospital and the pair become firm friends. He slowly falls in love with her and her baby, but she's still looking for the perfect partner, not realising he's right under her nose. However, we can hear the baby's thoughts, and he wants the guy as his dad.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Look Who's Talking Too
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A wisecracking toddler deals with toilet training, bickering parents and a baby sister in this sequel to the 1989 hit.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Look Who's Talking Now
skycinemafamily.uk.description: In the third of the 'Look Who's Talking' comedies, two dogs enter the Umbriacco household - and take an immediate dislike to each other. When Molly loses her job, husband James is forced to take on a demanding role as private airline pilot. The children miss him, so he buys a dog to cheer them up. However, when James's glamorous boss asks his family to look after her poodle, sparks fly between the dogs.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Scales of Justice; Crimes of Fashion
teennick.us.description: Lana springs into action when she learns her favorite fish are in jeopardy of losing their home to construction; when Leni gets fired from her job due to missing scarves, Lincoln and Clyde, as Ace and Jack, take on the case. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2018-07-20

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Predict Ability; Driving Ambition
teennick.us.description: After discovering he has rituals, Lincoln worries he's predictable and vows to change things up; Lori develops the yips when she finds out that the golf coach from her dream college is coming to see her play. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2019-02-05

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Exchange of Heart; Community Disservice
teennick.us.description: To divert the attention of his helicopter dads, Clyde arranges for an exchange student to stay with them; Lola takes a timid new classmate under her wing and gives her a social butterfly transformation. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2020-01-25

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - One of the Boys; A Tattler's Tale
teennick.us.description: Lincoln wishes he had 10 brothers instead of 10 sisters, and Lisa gives him a glimpse into that reality; Lola wants to be a part of the siblings' secrets club, but her siblings are reluctant to let in a tattle tale. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2016-10-17

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Making the Grade; Vantastic Voyage
teennick.us.description: Lincoln's social standing is at stake when his four-year-old sister is put into his fifth grade class; the children grow tired of their family van falling apart, so they decide to try to trick Dad into buying a cool, new van. (Animated, Children, Comedy) - 2017-02-24

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Date Expectations
teennick.us.description: Phoebe distracts Max from interfering with her class project by convincing him that a girl at school wants to date him. (Children, Sitcom) - 2015-11-18

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Ditch Perfect
teennick.us.description: When Phoebe learns Max's band plans to dump him, she suspects that his superhero training is hurting his friendships and attempts to help repair things. (Children, Sitcom) - 2017-02-25

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - It's Not What You Link
teennick.us.description: Phoebe's plan to get Max and Link to be friends backfires when Link starts spending more time with Max than her. (Children, Sitcom, Action, Adventure) - 2015-03-05

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Cape Fear
teennick.us.description: When Phoebe sneaks out to a party and saves someone's life, she asks Max to take credit for the save so she can remain on the superhero training path. (Children, Sitcom, Action, Adventure) - 2015-03-09

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - One Hit Thunder
teennick.us.description: Max causes a rift between Phoebe and Link when he uses personal information about them in a song for his band; Hank and Barb try to teach Billy and Nora a valuable lesson. (Children, Sitcom, Action) - 2015-03-11

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Orange Is the New Max
teennick.us.description: Phoebe worries that Max will revert to his evil ways after he is asked to give a "Scared Straight" talk to a group of young supervillains in prison, but her efforts to protect Max from himself end up doing more harm than good. (Children, Sitcom) - 2017-02-18

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Stealing Home
teennick.us.description: Hank and Phoebe think their house has been robbed when they return home and discover the furniture is missing. (Children, Sitcom) - 2016-08-13

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans: Undercover - No Friend in Sight
teennick.us.description: New adventures for The Thundermans unfold after Phoebe and Max are sent undercover to handle a new threat in the seaside town of Secret Shores; they must bring Chloe along to develop her superhero talent. (Children, Fantasy) - 2025-03-19

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans: Undercover - Prank You, Next
teennick.us.description: Max seeks help dealing with a mystery prankster at school from his old principal, who was always the target of his pranks. (Children, Fantasy) - 2025-04-09

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Four Supes and a Baby
teennick.us.description: The children wind up bringing home a real baby instead of Nora's doll when Phoebe drags Billy and Nora to the park to meet her crush and his baby brother. (Children, Sitcom, Adventure, Action) - 2014-09-20

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Doppel-Gamers
teennick.us.description: Max and Phoebe realize they have been neglecting their younger siblings when Billy and Nora bond with an outgoing pair of teens at a gamer's convention. (Children, Sitcom) - 2015-10-14

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Are You Afraid of the Park?
teennick.us.description: Max and Phoebe start a fight between Billy and Nora so they can avoid riding a scary roller coaster, but their scheme backfires when the feud escalates. (Children, Sitcom) - 2015-09-30

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Crime After Crime
teennick.us.description: Hank starts a neighborhood watch group; Max takes the blame for mysterious crimes to hide his secret. (Children, Sitcom) - 2014-01-11

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Significant Brother
teennick.us.description: Sparks fly between Phoebe and Cherry's visiting brother, prompting Cherry to grow concerned that she will be overshadowed by this new romance; after Cherry begs Phoebe not to date her brother, Phoebe must decide between love and friendship. (Children, Sitcom) - 2018-02-03

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Have an Ice Birthday
teennick.us.description: Phoebe and Max want to have a normal teenage birthday party; when a frozen Mrs Wong goes missing, they realize how good their family parties are. (Children, Sitcom, Action, Adventure) - 2014-03-22

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Revenge of the Smith
teennick.us.description: Excited to be honored for their heroism with a school mural, Phoebe and Max learn that the artist holds a personal grudge, and the tribute isn't what they imagined. (Children, Sitcom) - 2018-01-20

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Thunder Van
teennick.us.description: The children sneak into the Thundervan for an unauthorized joyride. (Children, Sitcom) - 2014-09-13

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Better Off Wed
teennick.us.description: When the children learn that Dr. Colosso ruined their parents' wedding years earlier, they decide to recreate Hank and Barb's dream day as their anniversary gift. (Children, Sitcom) - 2017-01-21

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - The Thundreth
teennick.us.description: Phoebe and Max are determined to make their 100th save their best and most memorable one yet, but by ignoring a series of small saves they overlook a supervillain plotting revenge on Hank and Barb. (Children, Sitcom) - 2018-05-25

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Looperheroes
teennick.us.description: The Z-Force gives Max and Phoebe a superhero day off, but when they relive the day over and over again, they must find a way to break the loop. (Children, Sitcom) - 2018-05-25

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - The Neverfriending Story
teennick.us.description: When Phoebe and Max's friends begin spending time with each other, the twins worry that they will be stuck together all the time. (Children, Sitcom, Action, Adventure) - 2015-02-24

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans: Undercover - The Mastermind Unmasked
teennick.us.description: Max and Phoebe discover that Lazlo Chance may be the evil mastermind and enlist Chloe to help; when Chloe is torn between her head and her heart, it threatens the entire mission. (Children, Fantasy) - 2025-10-08

themoviechannel.us.title: The Tribes of Palos Verdes
themoviechannel.us.description: When the situation at her idyllic Palos Verdes home turns volatile, young Medina attempts to surf her way to happiness. - 2017

themoviechannel.us.title: Smoke Signals
themoviechannel.us.description: A geeky American Indian travels from Idaho to Phoenix with a stoic companion whose father died. - 1998

themoviechannel.us.title: Love & Basketball
themoviechannel.us.description: From childhood to early adulthood, two friends (Sanaa Lathan, Omar Epps) fall in love while trying to establish basketball careers. - 2000

themoviechannel.us.title: She's All That
themoviechannel.us.description: A cool teen (Freddie Prinze Jr.) bets a friend that he can transform the school's geekiest girl (Rachael Leigh Cook) into a prom queen. - 1999

themoviechannel.us.title: Proof
themoviechannel.us.description: A depressed woman (Gwyneth Paltrow) copes with the death of her father (Anthony Hopkins), a brilliant but mentally ill mathematician. - 2005

themoviechannel.us.title: View From the Top
themoviechannel.us.description: A woman (Gwyneth Paltrow) from a small Nevada town makes friends while training to become a flight attendant. - 2003

themoviechannel.us.title: Mr. Holmes
themoviechannel.us.description: Long-retired and near the end of his life, Sherlock Holmes (Ian McKellen) grapples with an unreliable memory and must rely on his housekeeper's son as he revisits the still-unsolved case that led to his retirement. - 2015

themoviechannel.us.title: Haunter
themoviechannel.us.description: The ghost of a teenager (Abigail Breslin) tries to protect a young girl (Eleanor Zichy) and her family from a dead serial killer (Stephen McHattie) who can possess the living. - 2013

themoviechannel.us.title: The Dutchman
themoviechannel.us.description: Haunted by his crumbling marriage and an identity crisis, a successful but troubled businessman gets drawn into a psychological game of cat and mouse with a sinister, mysterious woman whom he encounters on a New York subway. - 2025

themoviechannel.us.title: Sleeping Dogs
themoviechannel.us.description: Suffering from memory loss, a former homicide detective tries to solve a brutal murder that he can't recall. As he pieces together evidence from a decade-old investigation, he soon uncovers a sinister web of buried secrets tied to his forgotten past. - 2024

themoviechannel.us.title: Gangs of New York
themoviechannel.us.description: During the era of Tammany Hall's sway, a young man (Leonardo DiCaprio) vows vengeance on the vicious gangster (Daniel Day-Lewis) who killed his father. - 2002

themoviechannel.us.title: Godzilla
themoviechannel.us.description: Godzilla, King of the Monsters, arises to combat massive, malevolent foes that have been feeding on a nuclear plant's reactors and now threaten mankind with total annihilation. - 2014

themoviechannel.us.title: The Contractor
themoviechannel.us.description: When his new assignment goes awry, an elite soldier finds himself hunted and on the run, caught in a dangerous conspiracy and fighting to stay alive long enough to get home and uncover the true motives of those who betrayed him. - 2022

themoviechannel.us.title: The November Man
themoviechannel.us.description: An ex-CIA agent (Pierce Brosnan) comes out of retirement to protect a valuable witness (Olga Kurylenko) and soon learns that now he is the target of his former friend and protégé (Luke Bracey). - 2014

themoviechannel.us.title: Patriot Games
themoviechannel.us.description: When former CIA agent Jack Ryan (Harrison Ford) hampers an IRA terrorist attack in London, he kills one of the terrorists. The dead man's brother, another member of the group named Sean Miller (Sean Bean), is arrested but quickly escapes. Vowing revenge against Ryan, Miller travels to the United States, where he forces Ryan's wife (Anne Archer) and daughter (Thora Birch) into a car accident that badly injures them. This convinces Ryan to rejoin the CIA in order to track down Miller. (Thriller, Action, Crime drama, Adventure, Mystery) - 1992

themoviechannel.us.title: Welcome to Sarajevo
themoviechannel.us.description: Michael Henderson is a reporter covering the war in Sarajevo, Bosnia and Herzegovina. He develops a competitive friendship with Flynn, an arrogant TV reporter, as they cover the chaos and suffering occurring around them. When Henderson reports on a dilapidated orphanage, he becomes affected by the plight of its occupants. With the help of an American aid worker named Nina, Henderson tries to find a way to smuggle the children out of the country. (Drama) - 1997

themoviechannel.us.title: Twisted
themoviechannel.us.description: Kara and Tyler are planning on getting married when Tyler's ex-girlfriend returns from rehab, determined to get her life back - starting with Tyler. (Thriller) - 2018

themoviechannel.us.title: The Outlaws
themoviechannel.us.description: A group of outlaws awaken to their empty train heist bag. Interrogations begin as each cowboy becomes the focus in an attempt to unmask the thief among them. Tensions mount as each bandit struggles to clear their name before bullets fly. (Crime drama, Mystery) - 2024

themoviechannel.us.title: The Stepford Wives
themoviechannel.us.description: After enduring setbacks in her television career, executive Joanna Eberhart (Nicole Kidman) relocates with her family from New York City to the Connecticut suburb of Stepford. While Joanna's husband, Walter (Matthew Broderick), quickly warms up to their new town, she has a hard time adjusting to Stepford's manicured environs and the overly accommodating attitude of the area women. Soon Joanna begins to suspect that something is not right, and she tries to uncover Stepford's secret. (Dark comedy, Horror, Thriller, Science fiction) - 2004

themoviechannel.us.title: Before Dawn
themoviechannel.us.description: A young man joins his countrymen on the Western front of World War I, hoping to expedite an end to the bloody conflict. However, as the battle rages on, he's forced to grapple with the brutal realities of trench warfare, including a near-constant struggle to keep himself alive without leaving another man behind. (War, Historical drama) - 2024

themoviechannel.us.title: Baby Driver
themoviechannel.us.description: Talented getaway driver Baby relies on the beat of his personal soundtrack to be the best in the game. After meeting the woman of his dreams, he sees a chance to ditch his shady lifestyle and make a clean break. Coerced into working for a crime boss, Baby must face the music as a doomed heist threatens his life, love and freedom. (Action, Thriller, Crime drama) - 2017

themoviechannel.us.title: Bleed for This
themoviechannel.us.description: Vinny "The Pazmanian Devil" Pazienza (Miles Teller), a local Providence boxer, shoots to stardom after winning two world title fights. After a near-fatal car accident leaves him with a broken neck, he is told he may never walk again. Against all odds and doctor's orders, renowned trainer Kevin Rooney (Aaron Eckhart) agrees to help Vinny return to the ring just a year after the accident for what could be the last fight of his life. Based on a true story. (Biography, Drama) - 2016

themoviechannel.us.title: Scream
themoviechannel.us.description: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody. (Horror, Comedy) - 1996

themoviechannel.us.title: Match Point
themoviechannel.us.description: Tennis instructor Chris Wilton (Jonathan Rhys-Meyers) grows friendly with Tom Hewett (Matthew Goode), a wealthy student who shares an interest in opera. Invited to attend a performance with Tom, Chris meets the family and instantly attracts Tom's sister, Chloe (Emily Mortimer). Chris marries her to get a job with her millionaire father, Alec (Brian Cox), but a dangerous affair with Nola Rice (Scarlett Johansson), Tom's American girlfriend, threatens his newfound social status. (Drama) - 2005

themoviechannel.us.title: Barron's Cove
themoviechannel.us.description: A man with a violent past kidnaps the boy he holds responsible for his son's death. As he grows closer to uncovering the truth, he's left to wonder whether his pursuers are really seeking to protect the boy, or merely the secrets he keeps. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 2024

themoviechannel.us.title: A Perfect Murder
themoviechannel.us.description: Wall Street baron Steven Taylor (Michael Douglas) discovers that his pretty young wife, Emily (Gwyneth Paltrow), is cheating on him. But what concerns him more than her infidelity is the hope of profiting from her untimely death. Emily has millions, and Steve's own financial empire is collapsing before his eyes. He hires her lover, David (Viggo Mortensen), to murder her. The plan -- to stage a break-in that will look like a random murder -- turns out to be far from perfect. (Thriller) - 1998

themoviechannel.us.title: Fatal Attraction
themoviechannel.us.description: For Dan Gallagher (Michael Douglas), life is good. He is on the rise at his New York law firm, is happily married to his wife, Beth (Anne Archer), and has a loving daughter. But, after a casual fling with a sultry book editor named Alex (Glenn Close), everything changes. Jilted by Dan, Alex becomes unstable, her behavior escalating from aggressive pursuit to obsessive stalking. Dan realizes that his main problem is not hiding his affair, but rather saving himself and his family. (Thriller, Drama, Romance) - 1987

turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A millionaire's nephew (Dick Powell) saves him from a gold digger and falls for a woman (Ruby Keeler) in a dress shop. - 1936

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Public Enemy
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Two hoodlums, Tom and Matt, rise up from their poverty-stricken slum life to become petty thieves, bootleggers and cold-blooded killers. But with street notoriety and newfound wealth, the duo feels the heat from the cops and rival gangsters both. - 1931

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Gold Diggers of 1933
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A songwriter's (Dick Powell) big check puts chorus girls (Joan Blondell, Ruby Keeler) to work but incurs his brother's wrath. - 1933

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: 42nd Street
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A Broadway producer (Warner Baxter) sends in the understudy (Ruby Keeler) when his show's star (Bebe Daniels) twists her ankle. - 1933

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Footlight Parade
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A director (James Cagney) creates and stages extravagant musical prologues for movie theaters. - 1933

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Arsenic and Old Lace
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A theater critic (Cary Grant) learns his two elderly aunts serve poisoned elderberry wine to lonely gentlemen callers. - 1944

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: State of the Union
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Aircraft tycoon Grant Matthews (Spencer Tracy) is goaded into running for president by his politically ambitious longtime girlfriend, newspaper publisher Kay Thorndyke (Angela Lansbury). At the suggestion of unscrupulous campaign manager Spike McManus (Van Johnson), Matthews reunites with his long-estranged wife, Mary (Katharine Hepburn), for the sake of appearances. But when the idealistic Mary learns of Kay's behind-the-scenes role, it throws the entire campaign into turmoil. (Comedy drama) - 1948

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Ladies of Leisure
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Wealthy artist Jerry Strong (Ralph Graves) offers a lift to Kay Arnold (Barbara Stanwyck), a weary woman rowing a boat in the river. Despite Kay's confession that she is a call-girl, Jerry finds her striking and asks her to pose for him. During the sessions, Jerry's partying best friend, Bill Standish (Lowell Sherman), admires Kay and makes a play for her. Kay declines Bill's invitation to go away with him, having fallen for Jerry -- only to have Jerry's scandalized, stuffy parents intrude. (Comedy drama) - 1930

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Mr. Deeds Goes to Town
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Longfellow Deeds (Gary Cooper), a resident of small-town Vermont, leads a simple life until he inherits a vast fortune from a late uncle. Soon, unscrupulous lawyer John Cedar (Douglas Dumbrille) brings Deeds to New York City, where the unassuming heir is the object of much media attention. When wily reporter Babe Bennett (Jean Arthur) gains the trust and affection of Deeds, she uses her position to publish condescending articles about him -- but are her feelings for him really that shallow? (Comedy) - 1936

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Small Town Girl
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Kay Brannan (Janet Gaynor) loathes her boring hometown and jumps at the opportunity to spend time with Robert Dakin (Robert Taylor), a wealthy playboy visiting from Boston. They wake up after a drunken night to find that they're married, despite Robert's pre-existing engagement to a socialite. In order to protect Robert's reputation, his parents insist that they wait six months before a divorce. During that time, Kay must wrestle with Robert's bitter fiancée as well as her feelings for him. (Romantic comedy) - 1936

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Strawberry Blonde
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: At the turn of the century, dentist Biff Grimes (James Cagney) recalls his association with politician Hugo Barnstead (Jack Carson). The men meet over their romantic rivalry for striking strawberry blonde Virginia Brush (Rita Hayworth). Despite Biff's efforts, Virginia pushes her friend, nurse and women's rights advocate Amy Lind (Olivia de Havilland), on him and elopes with Hugo. After Biff and Amy fall in love, Biff joins Hugo's firm, only to learn that his rival is still a double dealer. (Romantic comedy) - 1941

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Flower Drum Song
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In this adaptation of the 1958 Rodgers and Hammerstein Broadway musical, Chinese immigrant Mei Li (Miyoshi Umeki) is betrothed to nightclub boss Sammy Fong (Jack Soo), but he wants to marry showgirl Linda Low (Nancy Kwan). To get out of the arrangement, Sammy pawns her off to wealthy Master Wang (Benson Fong) as a fiancée for his son, Wang Ta (Victor Sen Yung). Mei Li falls in love with Wang, but he wants to pursue Linda, who takes advantage of his affections to test Sammy's love. (Musical comedy) - 1961

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Camelot
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: After the arranged marriage of Arthur (Richard Harris) and Guinevere (Vanessa Redgrave), the king gathers the noble knights of the realm to his Round Table. The dashing and stalwart Lancelot (Franco Nero) joins, but soon finds himself enraptured by the lovely Guinevere. When Arthur's illegitimate son, Mordred (David Hemmings), reappears in the kingdom and outs the secret lovers, Arthur finds himself trapped by his own rules into taking action against his wife and closest friend. (Musical) - 1967

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: An American in Paris
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Jerry Mulligan is an American ex-GI who stays in post-war Paris to become a painter, and falls for the gamine charms of Lise Bouvier. However, his paintings come to the attention of Milo Roberts, a rich American heiress, who is interested in more than just art. (Musical, Romance) - 1951

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Top Hat
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The story centers on wealthy Dale Tremont (Ginger Rogers), on holiday in London and Venice. She assumes that American entertainer Jerry Travers (Fred Astaire) is the husband of her friend Madge (Helen Broderick) -- who's actually the wife of Jerry's business manager Horace Hardwick (Edward Everett Horton). (Musical, Romance) - 1935

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: West Side Story
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A musical in which a modern day Romeo and Juliet are involved in New York street gangs. On the harsh streets of the upper west side, two gangs battle for control of the turf. The situation becomes complicated when a gang member falls in love with a rival's sister. (Musical) - 1961

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Places in the Heart
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In 1935 rural Texas, recently widowed Edna Spalding struggles to survive with two small children, a farm to run and very little money in the bank -- not to mention a deadly tornado and the unwelcome presence of the Ku Klux Klan. Edna is aided by her beautician sister, Margaret; a blind boarder, Mr. Will; and a would-be thief, Moze, who decides to stick around to teach Edna how to plant and harvest cotton. (Drama) - 1984

actionmax.us.title: Batman & Robin

actionmax.us.title: Joker

actionmax.us.title: Joker: Folie à Deux
actionmax.us.description: Struggling with his dual identity, failed comedian Arthur Fleck stumbles upon true love while incarcerated at Arkham State Hospital. Awaiting trial for the murder of five people, Fleck soon discovers the music that's always been inside him. - 2024

actionmax.us.title: Birds of Prey (and the Fantabulous Emancipation of One Harley Quinn)
actionmax.us.description: It's open season on Harley Quinn when her explosive breakup with the Joker puts a big fat target on her back. Unprotected and on the run, Quinn faces the wrath of narcissistic crime boss Black Mask, his right-hand man, Victor Zsasz, and every other thug in the city. But things soon even out for Harley when she becomes unexpected allies with three deadly women -- Huntress, Black Canary and Renee Montoya. (Action, Comedy) - 2020

actionmax.us.title: The Whistlers
actionmax.us.description: A Romanian police officer, determined to free from prison a crooked businessman who knows where a mobster's money is hidden, must learn the difficult ancestral language used on the island of Gomera. (Comedy drama, Thriller) - 2019

actionmax.us.title: Grudge Match
actionmax.us.description: Pittsburgh boxers Billy "The Kid" McDonnen (Robert De Niro) and Henry "Razor" Sharp (Sylvester Stallone) shared a fierce rivalry back in the 1980s. Each had scored a victory in two matches, but on the eve of their decisive third bout, Henry suddenly announced his retirement, effectively ending both boxers' careers. Thirty years later, boxing promoter Dante Slate Jr. (Kevin Hart) makes Billy and Henry an offer they can't refuse: Return to the ring and settle the score once and for all. (Comedy) - 2013

actionmax.us.title: Girls Trip
actionmax.us.description: Best friends Ryan, Sasha, Lisa and Dina are in for the adventure of a lifetime when they travel to New Orleans for the annual Essence Festival. Along the way, they rekindle their sisterhood and rediscover their wild side by doing enough dancing, drinking, brawling and romancing to make the Big Easy blush. (Comedy, Drama, Adventure) - 2017

actionmax.us.title: Wedding Crashers
actionmax.us.description: Jeremy (Vince Vaughn) and John (Owen Wilson) are divorce mediators who spend their free time crashing wedding receptions. For the irrepressible duo, there are few better ways to drink for free and bed vulnerable women. So when Secretary of the Treasury William Cleary (Christopher Walken) announces the wedding of his daughter, the pair make it their mission to crash the high-profile event. But their game hits a bump in the road when John locks eyes with bridesmaid Claire (Rachel McAdams). (Romantic comedy) - 2005

actionmax.us.title: Space Jam: A New Legacy
actionmax.us.description: Superstar LeBron James and his young son, Dom, get trapped in digital space by a rogue AI. To get home safely, LeBron teams up with Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck and the rest of the Looney Tunes gang for a high-stakes basketball game against the AI's digitized champions of the court -- a powered-up roster called the Goon Squad. (Children, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy, Animated) - 2021

actionmax.us.title: Nerve
actionmax.us.description: Industrious high school senior Vee Delmonico (Emma Roberts) is tired of living life on the sidelines. Pressured by her friends, Vee decides to join Nerve, a popular online game that challenges players to accept a series of dares. It's not long before the adrenaline-fueled competition requires her to perform increasingly dangerous stunts. When Nerve begins to take a sinister turn, Vee finds herself in a high-stakes finale that will ultimately determine her entire future. (Thriller, Action, Adventure, Crime drama) - 2016

actionmax.us.title: Black Butterfly
actionmax.us.description: On the outskirts of a mountain town grappling with a series of abductions and murders, Paul, a reclusive writer, struggles to start what he hopes will be a career-saving screenplay. After a tense encounter with a drifter named Jack, Paul offers Jack a place to stay. Soon, the edgy, demanding Jack muscles his way into Paul's work. As a storm cuts off power to the isolated cabin, the two men begin a jagged game that will bring at least one tale to an end. (Thriller) - 2017

actionmax.us.title: Aniara
actionmax.us.description: When a spacecraft carrying settlers to Mars strays off course, the consumption-obsessed passengers are prompted to consider their place in the universe. (Science fiction, Drama) - 2018

actionmax.us.title: Body at Brighton Rock
actionmax.us.description: Wendy, a part-time summer employee at a mountainous state park, takes on a rough trail assignment at the end of the season, trying to prove to her friends that she's capable enough to do the job. When she takes a wrong turn and ends up deep in the backcountry, she stumbles upon what might be a potential crime scene. Stuck with no communication after losing her radio and with orders to guard the site, Wendy must fight the urge to run. (Thriller) - 2019

actionmax.us.title: Horizon: An American Saga: Chapter 1

Once the best of friends, petty jealousies and a series of betrayals place them on a deadly collision course that reshapes organized crime forever. (Crime drama) - 2025

amcplus.us.title: True Crime Story - It Couldn't Happen Here: Vinalhaven, Maine
amcplus.us.description: On a remote island, a dispute between two lobstermen is settled the way islanders do: face-to-face; the conflict turns deadly when one swings an ax - leaving locals to dispute whether the death was self-defense or murder.

amcplus.us.title: True Crime Story - It Couldn't Happen Here: Adel, Georgia
amcplus.us.description: The town of Adel, Ga., is rocked by a brutal robbery homicide, and locals quickly point to an outsider as the killer; over 20 years later, new evidence raises the startling question if an innocent man is serving life for another man's crime.

amcplus.us.title: True Crime Story - It Couldn't Happen Here: Sauquoit, New York
amcplus.us.description: When a beloved chiropractor in Sauquoit, N.Y., dies suddenly under strange circumstances, investigators discover she's been murdered with a rare poison; the killer could only be someone she knew closely, and the case divides the town.

amcplus.us.title: True Crime Story - It Couldn't Happen Here: St. Augustine, Florida
amcplus.us.description: A young woman in St. Augustine, Fla., with everything to live for is found shot to death with the gun belonging to her boyfriend, a deputy sheriff; he says it was suicide, but her family believes it was murder.

amcplus.us.title: True Crime Story - It Couldn't Happen Here: Cookeville, Tennessee
amcplus.us.description: When an immigrant couple who settled in the Tennessee town of Cookeville is executed in their sleep and their house set on fire, investigators identify a suspect with motive; in their rush to make an arrest, they may have gotten the wrong man.

amcplus.us.title: True Crime Story - It Couldn't Happen Here: Shelbyville, Kentucky
amcplus.us.description: In rural Shelbyville, Ky., a body is found in the river; years go by until the police catch the killer, but some in town question if the suspect is even capable of committing the crime.

amcplus.us.title: True Crime Story - Rockville / Ellington, Connecticut
amcplus.us.description: When a 22-year-old dancer goes missing, the men of the neighboring town who frequented the club she worked at become the suspect pool; wealth and status may protect a killer; a determined police officer works the case.

amcplus.us.title: True Crime Story - It Couldn't Happen Here: Dallas, Ga.
amcplus.us.description: In this true-crime story, after a woman is found shot in her bathroom, officials launch a death investigation to determine if it was suicide -- as her husband claimed -- or murder; years later, the case remains open, and the town still has questions.

amcplus.us.title: True Crime Story - It Couldn't Happen Here: Pocomoke City, Md.
amcplus.us.description: In this true-crime story, a young single mother disappears without a trace; an investigation suggests she abandoned her children, while her family spends years proving she was murdered and finding her killers.

amcplus.us.title: True Crime Story - It Couldn't Happen Here: Angier, N.C.
amcplus.us.description: In this true crime story, a man claims he shot his daughter's estranged husband, Christian Griggs, in self-defense -- but after investigators close the case, Christian's family discovers evidence that the killing was not justified.

amcplus.us.title: True Crime Story - It Couldn't Happen Here: Iaeger, W.Va.
amcplus.us.description: In this true-crime story, a beloved town doctor perishes in a deadly house fire -- which investigators conclude was arson; but after securing a murder conviction, the prosecutor doubts his own evidence and joins the fight to free an innocent man.

amcplus.us.title: True Crime Story - It Couldn't Happen Here: Atwater, Ohio
amcplus.us.description: In this true-crime story, cold-case investigators looking into a double murder elicit a series of confessions from a group of teens; years later, the teens recant their statements; aggressive tactics may have sent an innocent man to death row.

amcplus.us.title: True Crime Story - It Couldn't Happen Here: Turlock, California
amcplus.us.description: A criminal defense attorney known for uncovering corruption finds himself on trial; accused of a complex murder-for-hire plot, along with eight others, he fights to clear his name and show the holes in the state's case.

moremax.us.title: The Daytrippers
moremax.us.description: Family members (Pat McNamara, Anne Meara) join a woman (Hope Davis) on an odyssey to confront her husband about a love letter addressed to him. - 1996

moremax.us.title: Rampage
moremax.us.description: When three different animals become infected with a dangerous pathogen, a primatologist and a geneticist team up to stop them from destroying Chicago. - 2018

moremax.us.title: Shazam!
moremax.us.description: Billy Batson is a streetwise 14-year-old who can magically transform into the adult superhero Shazam simply by shouting out one word. His newfound powers soon get put to the test when he squares off against the evil Dr. Thaddeus Sivana. - 2019

moremax.us.title: Shazam! Fury of the Gods
moremax.us.description: Bestowed with the powers of the gods, Billy Batson and his fellow foster kids are still learning how to juggle teenage life with their adult superhero alter egos. When a vengeful trio of ancient gods arrives on Earth in search of the magic stolen from them long ago, Shazam and his allies get thrust into a battle for their superpowers, their lives, and the fate of the world. (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2023

moremax.us.title: Twin Peaks: Fire Walk With Me
moremax.us.description: In the folksy town of Deerfield, Wash., FBI Agent Desmond (Chris Isaak) inexplicably disappears while hunting for the man who murdered a teen girl. The killer is never apprehended, and, after experiencing dark visions and supernatural encounters, Agent Dale Cooper (Kyle MacLachlan) chillingly predicts that the culprit will claim another life. Meanwhile, in the similarly cozy town of Twin Peaks, hedonistic beauty Laura Palmer (Sheryl Lee) hangs with lowlifes and seems destined for a grisly fate. (Crime drama) - 1992

moremax.us.title: Smoking Tigers
moremax.us.description: Lonely 16-year-old Korean American Hayoung tries to hide her problematic family and lower-income background from her new wealthy friends. (Drama) - 2023

moremax.us.title: Trap
moremax.us.description: A man and his teenage daughter realize they're at the center of a dark and sinister event while watching a concert. (Thriller) - 2024

moremax.us.title: Epic
moremax.us.description: Mary Katherine (Amanda Seyfried), or M.K., is a headstrong, spirited teenager who has a strained relationship with her father (Jason Sudeikis). She loses patience with her dad's tales of unseen people who live in the woods, but when she is magically transported to that mythic realm, she gains new perspective. M.K. joins a race of beings known as the Leafmen in their battle to protect their queen (Beyoncé Knowles) from their enemies, evil Mandrake (Christoph Waltz) and his crew of Boggans. (Animated, Children, Adventure, Action, Comedy) - 2013

moremax.us.title: Once Were Brothers: Robbie Robertson and The Band
moremax.us.description: The story of a band that went from backing up Bob Dylan to becoming one of the most influential groups of its era. (Music) - 2019

moremax.us.title: Colette
moremax.us.description: After moving to Paris, author Sidonie-Gabrielle Colette agrees to ghostwrite a semi-autobiographical novel for her husband. Its success soon inspires her to fight for creative ownership and overcome the societal constraints of the early 20th century. (Biography, Historical drama) - 2018

moremax.us.title: Miss Sloane
moremax.us.description: Willing to bend the rules for her clients, Elizabeth Sloane (Jessica Chastain) remains one of the most sought-after lobbyists in Washington, D.C. When asked to help oppose a bill that imposes regulations on firearms, she instead joins a scrappy boutique firm that represents the backers of the law. Her defiant stance and determination to win now makes her the target of powerful new enemies who threaten her career and the people she cares about. (Drama, Thriller) - 2016

moremax.us.title: Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri
moremax.us.description: After months have passed without a culprit in her daughter's murder case, Mildred Hayes makes a bold move, painting three signs leading into her town with a controversial message directed at William Willoughby, the town's revered chief of police. When his second-in-command, Officer Dixon -- an immature mother's boy with a penchant for violence -- gets involved, the battle is only exacerbated. (Crime drama, Dark comedy) - 2017

moremax.us.title: Spring Breakers
moremax.us.description: College students Candy (Vanessa Hudgens), Faith (Selena Gomez), Brit (Ashley Benson) and Cotty (Rachel Korine) are short of the cash they need for a spring-break trip, so they rob a diner and head down to Florida. However, the police soon break up the party and arrest them. The curvaceous quartet is unexpectedly bailed out by a drug dealer and aspiring rap artist named Alien (James Franco). Soon after, three of the four gal pals decide to join Alien in a life of crime. (Comedy, Crime drama) - 2012

moremax.us.title: Lady Bird
moremax.us.description: A teenager (Saoirse Ronan) navigates a loving but turbulent relationship with her strong-willed mother (Laurie Metcalf) over the course of an eventful and poignant senior year of high school. (Comedy drama) - 2017

moremax.us.title: Life of Pi
moremax.us.description: After deciding to sell their zoo in India and move to Canada, Santosh and Gita Patel board a freighter with their sons and a few remaining animals. Tragedy strikes when a terrible storm sinks the ship, leaving the Patels' teenage son, Pi, as the only human survivor. However, Pi is not alone; a fearsome Bengal tiger has also found refuge aboard the lifeboat. As days turn into weeks and weeks drag into months, Pi and the tiger must learn to trust each other if both are to survive. (Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery) - 2012

natgeo.ca.description: Renowned dog behaviorist Cesar Millan comes back not only to rehabilitate dogs, but to train pet parents as well. With empty shelters and dog adoptions at a record high, his return to television gives new pet parents the tools they need to teach their dogs good habits and shed the bad ones. In addition, he helps pet parents better understand the connection that dogs have with their humans, and how people's actions can influence just how well, or poorly, their dogs behave. From the yards of the pet owners to his newly updated Dog Psychology Center, Cesar demonstrates the skills needed to create happy homes with furry best friends while equipped with a can-do attitude. BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E17 The Power of Kroll: Part 1 Tracing the fifth segment of the Key to Time to the third moon of Delta Magna, the Doctor and Romana are soon caught up in the conflict between humans and the Swampies.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E18 The Power of Kroll: Part 2 The Doctor arrives in time to save Romana from being sacrificed to the bogus god, Kroll. But it’s not long before the very real Kroll makes its terrifying appearance.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E19 The Power of Kroll: Part 3 With the giant, squid-like Kroll awake and angry, the Swampies are eager to appease their god by using the Doctor and Romana as sacrificial victims.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E20 The Power of Kroll: Part 4 With Kroll on the rampage, the Doctor and Romana are appalled to discover that Thawn intends to fire a rocket at the creature which will also kill the Swampies.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E1 Destiny of the Daleks: Part 1 The TARDIS lands on the old Dalek homeworld of Skaro where the Doctor and the newly regenerated Romana discover that someone is digging deep beneath the planet’s surface.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E2 Destiny of the Daleks: Part 2 Romana is captured and interrogated by the Daleks whilst the Doctor meets the Movellans who are equally interested in discovering exactly what the Daleks are searching for.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E3 Destiny of the Daleks: Part 3 Davros has awoken from his centuries long slumber and is taken prisoner by the Doctor before the Daleks can reach him. But the Daleks will stop at nothing to recover their creator.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S16 E16 The Androids of Tara: Part 4 The Doctor attempts to gain entry to the castle to prevent the marriage of Romana to Prince Reynart and thwart Grendal’s plans to rule Tara.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E6 City of Death: Part 2 The Doctor and Romana become the reluctant guests of Scarlioni who is planning to steal the Mona Lisa despite having six Mona Lisas hidden in his cellar – all of them genuine.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E7 City of Death: Part 3 Count Scarlioni is revealed to really be Scaroth, last of the Jagaroth and is funding the construction of a time machine – but for what purpose?

BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E8 City of Death: Part 4 Scaroth intends to travel back in time to save his own people from destruction. But the Doctor can’t allow him to succeed as it would mean the destruction of all life on Earth.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E9 The Creature from the Pit: Part 1 The Doctor and Romana follow a distress signal to the jungle world of Chloris. The planet is ruled by the ruthless Lady Adrasta who takes the Doctor prisoner.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E10 The Creature from the Pit: Part 2 The Doctor has escaped Adrasta’s wrath by jumping down the pit into the last remaining metal mine on Chloris. But the pit is also the home of a monstrous creature.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E11 The Creature from the Pit: Part 3 In the pit, the Doctor establishes contact with the creature and begins to suspect that all is not as it seems.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E12 The Creature from the Pit: Part 4 With Erato now able to communicate, the truth of Adrasta’s scheming is revealed but a terrible retribution has already been put in motion.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E13 Nightmare of Eden: Part 1 A terrible hyperspace accident results in two starships becoming locked together. The Doctor arrives and discovers that the incident may have also released a deadly menace.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E14 Nightmare of Eden: Part 2 The Doctor and Romana are horrified to discover that Tryst has been storing real lifeforms in his CET machine and that someone is smuggling the dangerous narcotic, Vraxoin.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E15 Nightmare of Eden: Part 3 The terrifying Mandrels have escaped from Eden and are attacking everyone aboard the Empress. The Doctor and Romana, accused of being smugglers, are pursued by customs officers.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S17 E16 Nightmare of Eden: Part 4 The Doctor solves the mystery of the drug smuggling racket and the culprits are revealed. But unless the Doctor and Romana act quickly, the villains will escape justice.

ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E12 Gotcha In order to do research for her tell-all memoir about men, Lumpy Space Princess goes undercover working for Finn and Jake.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E37 Career Day Robin forces the other Titans to find regular, boring jobs.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E40 Various Modes of Transportation With the other Titans away, Cyborg is forced to take a road trip with Robin.

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Amazing World of Gumball ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E27 The Menu The prize jewel on the Secret Joyful Burger menu is a mysterious burger, but to order it you need to know its name. When Larry refuses to tell them what it's called, they go to super-sized lengths to discover it.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Super Happy Magic Forest
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E37 New Broom The witch casts a spell of squeaky voices on the heroes which will be lifted once they have completed a quest to the Super Creepy Haunted Forest.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Submarine Jim
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E4 Pit Stop Water consumption in the submarine restrooms is too high. Jim introduces water-saving measures with the help of his eco-minded crew. But with good intentions clashing with urgent needs, how will it all play out?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Total Dramarama
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E21 A Ninjustice To Harold Harold's world is turned upside down when his classmates declare Beth is the real class ninja.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E23 Kuro Neko If Cat Noir decided to quit and give his Miraculous back to Ladybug, who could possibly replace him?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Ninjago
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E2 Home Back in training mode with the looming threat of Lloyd and the Hypnobrai, Zane wanders after a Falcon and lands himself in a heap of trouble. The rest of the Ninja leave the training dojo to help him.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Shaun The Sheep: Brain Breaks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E4 Get Gran Home Power up this lost granny by moving left and right, and running on the spot - that way you'll help this little old lady dodge debris on the road and make her way home. But hurry up, she hasn't got all day!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Alphablocks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E25 Snail A SNAIL starts to CHOMP through the Alphablocks' vegetable garden. In a FLASH, it becomes large and fast. They follow its TRAIL and work out that it needs its own GREEN patch.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Colourblocks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E4 Red Meets Blue Red is surprised to discover she's not the only colour in the world when she meets Blue. Join the Colourblocks to learn which objects can be red and which can be blue, and how some can be both red AND blue.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Numberblocks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E1 One A little block falls out of the sky, meets her numberling and discovers one wonderful world, singing and counting to one. Learn all about the number 1 with Numberblock One!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Wonderblocks ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E22 Someone's Been Eating My Porridge Detectives Go and Stop are on a special mission. They need to discover who ate Little Bear's porridge.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Super Why's Comic Book Adventures ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E20 Battle of the Villains! It's Mr. More versus The Eraser in a battle of the opposites!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Dance With Tom
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E4 Kuruhman - Kangaroo Tom Teaches a Kuruhman dance. Kuruhman is the Yugambeh word for Kangaroo, who are curious and listen very carefully to the sounds of the bush. Join Tom and learn to be strong and patient, just like the great Kuruhman!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E11 How Does It Work? Wind-up Toy In today's episode it's playtime! Maddie is finding out about wind-up toys and how they move along.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Understanding Numbers
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E4 Subtilising to 5 Learn how to instantly recognise small quantities of objects without counting them. This skill is called subitising and is used to identify how many items there are in a collection just by looking.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Wordsville
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E18 The Case Of The Not-so-tranquil Town When the word TRANQUILITY is ripped off Vet Wilder's \.

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Brilliant World Of Tom Gates
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E17 Nice Cup Of Tea Tom and Derek agree to listen to Derek's Dad's record collection with the promise of getting some tasty cake for after. Liz shows us how to doodle on a cake.

ABCMESydney.au.title: My Place
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E23 1788 Waruwi Waruwi discovers a platoon of marines led by a young drummer boy coming though the bush. The cow they're after has wandered into her camp and she has to find a way to put them off the track.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Media Stamped
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E4 What's in a Frame? Would you rather hang out with a Citizen or a Suspect? Research shows words have the power to completely change your opinion about a person, a news story, or even an entire concept!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Know It Alls: Visual Art
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E5 Art Overall Comedian Carlo Ritchie goes head to head with Shantini and Janaki at the National Gallery of Australia. Are two child-sized-heads cleverer than one adult-sized-head? Has Carlo been set-up to fail?

ABCMESydney.au.title: BtN Newsbreak
ABCMESydney.au.description: E197 Episode 197 Find out what's going on in the world with a news bulletin designed for children, featuring stories that are relevant and easy to understand.

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
ABCMESydney.au.description: S9 E2 Garage And Canal Barge George meets a mum determined to turn a broken shed into a three-room haven, and a young couple trying to create a luxury home on a houseboat. In Chile, George visits a stunning temple and continues to build his observatory.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Not Going Out
ABCMESydney.au.description: S10 E2 Holiday Share Can Lee and Lucy's friendship with Toby and Anna survive a long weekend in a cottage in the New Forest? The beautiful countryside is quickly forgotten as they squabble over bedrooms, day trips, cooking and cleaning.

PittsburghPenguins.nhl.title: NHL Hockey : Boston Bruins at Pittsburgh Penguins ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
PittsburghPenguins.nhl.description: Live NHL action with the Boston Bruins (11-4-1) at the Pittsburgh Penguins (5-7-2). Live from the PPG Paints Arena.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E23 The Vegetable Patch Lidia works in her garden; she reminisces the lessons that her grandma taught her about her vegetable patch. She makes a country salad as well as green beans with new potatoes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Cheese Slices
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E7 USA Will Studd visits the finest cheese shops in down town New York to find out what's driving this extraordinary change, before visiting upstate Vermont, where he meets a new generation of cheese makers.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Food Trail South Africa
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E3 Wild Kwa-Zulu Natal The wild northeast coast of South Africa is like nothing you've seen. And it's here Warren will find himself romanced by empty beaches, rugged open oceans, and waterways filled with wild hippopotamus.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Dolce Vita Riviera
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E8 Santa Margherita Ligure Santa Margherita Ligure reveals itself as a town where life is enjoyed at every hour of the day. Luana happily loses herself in its lively streets, discovering one of Liguria's most beloved tradition.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Jokkmokk, Sweden Far above the Arctic Circle, Tareq explores the wild country around Jokkmokk.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E5 Maria Morgan: Ox Tail Stew & Vegie Bake Marie Morgan draws on the Kimberley history of station and mission days. Marie shares with us a family recipe that takes us back to a simpler time.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E14 An Autumn Party Maggie introduces Simon to her outdoor wood-fired oven, and he uses it to make some pottery with a very special meal inside. Autumn is Maggie's favourite season.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E28 Episode 28 Laura uses local Adelaide Hills produce to make her delicious Red Wine Poached Pears. Chef Charlie Carrington and farmer Catherine Velisha join forces to showcase spring onions with a unique Za'atar.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E28 Albanian Pizza With Muscles And Pasta Rachael's friends, Leida and Veina, are showing how to make three types of Albanian Pizza, a rustic dish made with phyllo dough filled with beef, chicken, and potatoes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Little Manly Point Hayden sets up the BBQ in the park at Little Manly Point and has a tasty range of dishes ready to go: butterflied chicken, salmon flatbreads, and rotisserie mushrooms.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Not Your Butter Chicken
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Ready To Roti This episode centres on the resilience of South Asian women throughout the hardships of migration.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E23 Episode 23 Laura makes some muesli bars and spaghetti alla Nerano; chef Masa cooks some seafood yaki udon; Catherine makes kangaroo salad.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Good Food Everyday With Gary Mehigan
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Episode 3 Guest Paul Mercurio presents flavour-packed recipes including lamb backstraps with artichokes and capers, open pita with grilled haloumi, and roasted lamb rack.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E52 Episode 52 We've all had bacon and eggs at some point, but have you had them baked all together in a pan?

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E85 Have A Go Eco-entrepreneur Lottie Dalziel and Chef of the Year Jo Barrett join Adam to demonstrate how to have a go at their favourite food fundamentals.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Family Dineasties
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Episode 1 Kylie Kwong and Kevin La cook and dine with the family chefs from Sun Ming Parramatta, Tang Bou and Hangang as well as dropping by Kevin's Dad's much loved grocery store in Bonnyrigg.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Nigella Express
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E9 Speedy Gonzalez It's fast, fabulous and packs a big flavour punch. Nigella's cooking Latin influenced food the express way. For the family: a fabulous ever-ready sweet corn chowder, topped with tortilla chips.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Stanley Tucci: Searching For Italy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Tuscany Tuscany is the birthplace of the Renaissance and world-class art, architecture and culture. It's also produced some of the finest wines and dishes in the history of Italian cuisine.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: A Taste Of Island Dreams
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Lemon Chilli Chicken With Turmeric Rice Learn to cook a signature dish at Island Dreams Cafe and an all-round family favourite. Alimah Bilda shares a version with a punchier, thicker sauce that coats the chicken and rice.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Anthony Bourdain: A Cook's Tour
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E15 A Pleasing Palate Tony attempts to dispel the myth that all English food is disgusting and over-boiled. Tony tries Nose to Tail Eating, and explores traditional fare at Pie and Mash Shoppes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Anthony Bourdain: A Cook's Tour
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E16 My Hometown Favourites Tony gives us an intimate tour of the New York City foods he loves - sturgeon and bagels, fluke ceviche, braised veal cheek, authentic cheese and, of course, a hotdog.

SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E85 Have A Go Eco-entrepreneur Lottie Dalziel and Chef of the Year Jo Barrett join Adam to demonstrate how to have a go at their favourite food fundamentals.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S6 E5 Karlstad: Food From Two Seasons Tareq visits sunny Karlstad! Here, food is prepared by Vanern's shores and in Varmland's deep forests. Butter-fried Zander, crepes and cooking over an open fire are on the menu.

SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E4 Some Like It Hot Hot sauce hive unite! Mary spices it up with recipes that bring the heat, including maple sriracha salmon and spicy pickled Caesar beans.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E24 Fruits And Sweets In the summer, it was time to wait for the fruits in Lidia's trees to ripen. She prepares a fig and prosciutto bruschetta, wafer cookies into truffles, and make almond tarts from Andria.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Cheese Slices
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E1 Cheeses Of Greece The ancient Greeks regarded cheese as Food of the Gods, and it's no surprise that in Greece today, the consumption of cheese per head of population is the highest in the world.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Food Trail South Africa
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E4 Madikwe Safari In this episode, Warren experiences the abundance of wildlife here, centering his experience around tracking and finding the elusive and endangered African Wild Dog.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Dolce Vita Riviera
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E9 Rapallo Rapallo keeps its secrets well. Behind its tranquil appearance lies a town full of delightful surprises. Luana begins by ascending to the Sanctuary of Montallegro.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Bergen, Norway Bergen is a thousand-year-old city built on the back of the seafood trade especially cod.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E6 Bo Carne: Nana's Half Caste Stew & Magpie Goose Giblet & Heart Blachan Everyone has a stew they can brag about. In this episode, Bo Carne shares his Nana's version of the good old billabong stew.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E15 Autumn Fruit And Nuts Its Autumn and the new seasons array of Fruit and Nuts sees Maggie and Simon whip up a collection of captivating flavours. For Maggie, Autumn means Vintage in the Barossa.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E29 Episode 29 Laura's mum, Anita, joins her in the kitchen with a quick family favourite, Zucchini Pasta. Guest host Shane Jolley teams up with Chef Mod to cook an Asian classic, Seared Salmon in Massaman Curry.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E29 Cacciatore With Jeremy Sisto Actor and family friend Jeremy Sisto joins Rachael in her Tuscan kitchen to learn how to make Hunter's Chicken, known in Italy as Cacciatore served with generous helpings of bruschetta.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E6 Little Manly Beach The BBQ is setup on the pier overlooking Little Manly on a perfect day for Hayden's recipes: Portuguese chicken burgers, tarte Tatin, and mushroom-stuffed salmon.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Not Your Butter Chicken
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Darkness To Light This episode, filmed during the festival of light known as Diwali, focuses on the new era of Indo-Canadians rewriting the script on family as they celebrate a fresh take on cultural traditions.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E24 Episode 24 Laura & Daen prepare a baked snapper with salsa verde; Heather makes kake soba with fish cakes & onsen eggs; Tobie Puttock cooks raspberry chia jam cooked on renewable gas; Catherine puts together a Dominican traditional soup with a twist.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Good Food Everyday With Gary Mehigan
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Episode 4 This episode highlights heart-healthy, diabetes-conscious recipes: T-bone steak with garlic and herb baste, a fetta and quinoa salad with cumin dressing, and Bò lá lôt.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E53 Episode 53 Have you ever folded your pizza in on itself? It is delicious!

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E86 Gather Around It's time to gather around, as urban gardener Connie Cao and chef Alastair McLeod join Adam to make food that's best for sharing.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Outback Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Episode 4 Justine explores Darwin, visiting the Parap Markets and enjoys a beautiful breakfast laksa. She then joins MasterChef alumni Rachel Ciesiolka for a seafood cook-off at Rachel's Seafood Shack.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: A Girl's Guide to Hunting, Fishing and Wild Cooking
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Episode 4 Conquering her fear of bees, Analiese gets her first beehive before heading off on an adventure of foraging, fishing and diving with best friend and famous Thai restaurateur, Palisa Anderson.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Paddock To Plate
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E8 The Kimberley As his journey concludes, Matt explores the vast Kimberley Region and it's spectacular coast. He cooks locally farmed barramundi, mud crab and pearl meat and travels to a cattle station for an end-of-muster feast.

SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E17 The French Laundry Experience Marooned in San Francisco, Tony tastes local shellfish and durian ice cream before embarking on a pilgrimage to experience the genius of Thomas Keller, chef, and owner of The French Laundry.

oxygenwest.us.title: Forensic Files
oxygenwest.us.description: S13 E04 Political Thriller Pathologist examining the death of a politician who was running for re-election finds tiny puncture wounds at the autopsy.

oxygenwest.us.title: Forensic Files
oxygenwest.us.description: S11 E02 Going for Broke A Russian immigrant is found dead and a strange phone call to his office is the only lead investigators have.

oxygenwest.us.title: Forensic Files
oxygenwest.us.description: S11 E03 Just Desserts Physical evidence initially condemns a prime suspect to a double homicide, but DNA from a discarded spoon points to another.

oxygenwest.us.title: Forensic Files
oxygenwest.us.description: S11 E04 Sunday's Wake A young girl falls ill and dies; forensic investigators search for evidence halfway around the world to shed light on the tragic death.

oxygenwest.us.title: Forensic Files
oxygenwest.us.description: S10 E05 Soiled Plan Detectives are suspicious after a woman is killed in a hunting accident, but it takes more than twenty years before a trace evidence analyst is able to match fibers on a soiled blanket to the killer.

oxygenwest.us.title: Forensic Files
oxygenwest.us.description: S10 E06 Headquarters When hunters find a skull in a Texas canyon, police find bits of clothing, a woman's shoe, some small bones and a strand of hair; once they discover her identity, it was time to find the killer.

oxygenwest.us.title: Forensic Files
oxygenwest.us.description: S10 E07 One for the Road A wife is missing in Key West; investigators wonder if they should be searching for a missing person or a killer.

oxygenwest.us.title: Forensic Files
oxygenwest.us.description: S10 E09 Shear Luck The violent death of an Air Force officer's wife outside a Philippines air base is examined, amid accusations of a love triangle involving the murdered woman's husband; investigators use groundbreaking computer forensics to make their case.

oxygenwest.us.title: Forensic Files
oxygenwest.us.description: S10 E10 Tagging a Suspect Pieces of plastic the size of sand hold clues to a bombing.

oxygenwest.us.title: Forensic Files
oxygenwest.us.description: S10 E11 Strong Impressions At first glance it appears a young woman suffocated, but further investigation shows the scene was staged.

oxygenwest.us.title: Forensic Files
oxygenwest.us.description: S10 E12 Cereal Killer A killer is careless when a home is destroyed by fire and a young boy is missing.

oxygenwest.us.title: Forensic Files
oxygenwest.us.description: S10 E13 Crash Course A patrol officer is shocked by the amount of blood at a traffic accident and is shocked by the coroner's ruling until an anonymous phone call re-ignites the case.

oxygenwest.us.title: Forensic Files
oxygenwest.us.description: S10 E15 A Leg up on Crime An irrigation canal murder remains unsolved until a similar murder occurs.

oxygenwest.us.title: Forensic Files
oxygenwest.us.description: S10 E16 Tight-Fitting Genes The light of day and DNA picture painted by molecular biologist reveals new clues about a nighttime traffic accident.

oxygenwest.us.title: Snapped: Killer Moms
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E03 Kelly Turner When a Colorado mother claims her daughter is mysteriously ill, doctors question if they have a Munchausen by proxy case. The investigation reveals the horrific truth behind the lengths a mother is willing to go with her child's life for attention.

oxygenwest.us.title: Snapped: Killer Moms
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E02 Cynthia Cdebaca When a California man is found riddled with bullets in his own home, the investigation leads to an unconventional suspect close to the victim; a bizarre interrogation leaves a daughter heartbroken by the actions her mother took to protect her.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline
oxygenwest.us.description: S07 E48 On a Dark, Deserted Highway A deadly high-speed chase in Montana leads "Dateline" on a search through 50 years of history to unravel the mystery of how one man turned into a monster and committed one of the state's most notorious crimes.

oxygenwest.us.description: S04 E08 Mystery in South Beach A young woman is found dead in an empty warehouse parking lot Miami -- just four days after her wedding.

oxygenwest.us.title: Manson: The Women
oxygenwest.us.description: Fifty years after the infamous Manson Family murders, a look at the trail of the women who blindly followed Charles Manson; including new and exclusive interviews.

oxygenwest.us.title: Accident, Suicide, or Murder
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E11 Young Deadly Love A young man calls 911 to report that his fiancée fatally shot herself in their bed; her family insists she would never take her own life; the investigation drags on for years, until an unexpected development leads to a stunning conclusion.

oxygenwest.us.title: Accident, Suicide, or Murder
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E03 Lover's Chair Investigators uncover a web of lies a decade after a couple's romantic evening atop Rockefeller Lookout in New Jersey ends with the wife's tragic death.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Secrets Uncovered
oxygenwest.us.description: S06 E01 The Sting Newlywed Dalia Dippolito returns home from the gym to the awful news that her husband had been killed; in a case where almost nothing is as it seems, investigators want to know if Dalia is diabolical or an unwitting pawn in a hoax gone wrong.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Secrets Uncovered
oxygenwest.us.description: S06 E02 Dark Valley When the dashing Gavin Smith vanishes, LA detectives are unsure if they are investigating a crime or a suicide; his wife claims he had gotten lost in drugs and flings; police wonder if the key to finding Gavin is hidden in one of those affairs.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Secrets Uncovered
oxygenwest.us.description: S06 E03 Black Friday Ashlea Harris has no shortage of admirers, so when she is found dead after a suspicious fire consumes her apartment, police are baffled; the fire is no accident but the clues to who killed Ashlea may be up in smoke.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Secrets Uncovered
oxygenwest.us.description: S06 E04 Out There In the Dark Brandy Daniels believes someone is stalking her, then the single mother is found slumped over in her car, shot dead; investigators spend years navigating the twists and turns searching for her killer.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Secrets Uncovered
oxygenwest.us.description: S06 E05 The Women & Dirty John Debra Newell thought she found Mr. Right, but her daughters sensed something wrong about John Meehan; they started digging into his past and their search for answers exposed a dangerous con man.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Secrets Uncovered
oxygenwest.us.description: S06 E06 As Night Fell Heidi and Conrad Truman are an enviable couple with a bright future until Heidi is found shot; in the aftermath, fingers are pointed but could be aimed at an innocent person.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Secrets Uncovered
oxygenwest.us.description: S06 E07 Good & Evil When a woman's body is discovered at a trash facility, a detective makes a promise to her mother to get justice; she doesn't know she will come face to face with a serial killer.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Secrets Uncovered
oxygenwest.us.description: S06 E08 Deadly Trust Wealthy residents feel safe in their gated community, but it is not safe for one millionaire, murdered in his waterfront home; police investigate, but the case grows cold; turns out the key to solving it, or two keys, is right at the front door.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Secrets Uncovered
oxygenwest.us.description: S06 E09 The Shadow The save the date cards had gone out; Angie Ver Huel went to sleep next to her fiancé, Justin Michael, with big dreams but woke up to a nightmare; someone was running from their bedroom and Justin was dead.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Secrets Uncovered
oxygenwest.us.description: S06 E10 Internal Affairs A beautiful, popular graduate student is shot dead outside her apartment in Durham, North Carolina.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Secrets Uncovered
oxygenwest.us.description: S06 E11 The Trap A murder occurs in an affluent neighborhood with tree-lined streets; investigators find a riddle, a deception and a piece of pure evil.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Secrets Uncovered
oxygenwest.us.description: S06 E12 Deadly Twist Todd Winkler claims self-defense after being arrested for killing his wife, Rachel; investigators travel to Georgia to find out how Todd's first wife died on a camping trip 10 years earlier.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Secrets Uncovered
oxygenwest.us.description: S07 E01 Devil's Bathtub Craig and Laura Rideout appear happy, but after they separate, an ugly secret is revealed and one of them will soon be dead; clues point to four possible killers and leave investigators wondering if this murder is all in the family.

wdrb.us.title: The Simpsons
wdrb.us.description: This long-running animated comedy focuses on the eponymous family in the town of Springfield in an unnamed U.S. state. The head of the Simpson family, Homer, is not a typical family man. A nuclear-plant employee, he does his best to lead his family but often finds that they are leading him. The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. Other Springfield residents include the family's religious neighbor, Ned Flanders, family physician Dr. Hibbert, Moe the bartender and police chief Clancy Wiggum. (Animated, Sitcom) - 1989-12-17

wdrb.us.title: Young Sheldon
wdrb.us.description: For young Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naive Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son. For 12 years on "The Big Bang Theory," audiences came to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. In "Young Sheldon," audiences get a chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. Jim Parsons, who plays the adult version of Sheldon on "The Big Bang Theory," narrates. (Sitcom) - 2017-09-25

The cases that are featured are bone-chilling and almost unbelievable. In some cases, it is seen where a rain puddle can preserve DNA, or a snow pile can feature footprints.
