fxm.us.title: The Song of Bernadette
fxm.us.description: Based on the popular novel by Franz Werfel, this drama focuses on Bernadette Soubirous (Jennifer Jones), a young French woman who experiences vivid visions of the Virgin Mary. While many dismiss her claims, certain people, including the priest Dominique Peyramale (Charles Bickford), slowly begin to believe her. Eventually, Bernadette is deemed a saint, and becomes a nun at a convent, where she must deal with jealousy from others who resent her revered status. (Drama) - 1943

fxm.us.title: The Lodger
fxm.us.description: In London in 1889, retiree Robert Burton (Cedric Hardwicke) and his wife, Ellen (Sara Allgood), rent a spare room to the mysterious Slade (Laird Cregar) as Jack the Ripper continues to terrorize the city. The Burtons' niece, Kitty (Merle Oberon), is a music hall singer who initially grows fond of the eccentric lodger, but, when the Ripper's body count rises, she and a Scotland Yard inspector (George Sanders) gradually begin to suspect that Slade could be the notorious Whitechapel killer. (Thriller) - 1944

fxm.us.title: Leave Her to Heaven
fxm.us.description: While on a train, writer Richard Harland (Cornel Wilde) strikes up a relationship with the gorgeous Ellen Berent (Gene Tierney). Ellen quickly becomes obsessed with Richard and abandons her fiancé, Russell Quinton (Vincent Price), to be with him. The couple rushes into marriage, with both of them caught up in romance and Richard intrigued by Ellen's intensity. Only after settling into marriage, however, does Richard realize that she is psychotically jealous and highly unstable. (Crime drama) - 1945

fxm.us.title: The Terrorists
fxm.us.description: Attempting to secure the release of political prisoners, a terrorist group, led by the fierce Ray Petrie (Ian McShane), takes over a British plane. Tough Scandinavian operative Nils Tahlvik (Sean Connery) is sent in to deal with the armed men and free the aircraft's passengers. Unfortunately for Tahlvik, the terrorists prove to be quite formidable. Meanwhile, another unit of the same extremist organization is holding an English ambassador hostage, which further complicates matters. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 1974

fxm.us.title: Laura
fxm.us.description: In one of the most celebrated 1940s film noirs, Manhattan detective Mark McPherson (Dana Andrews) investigates the murder of Madison Avenue executive Laura Hunt (Gene Tierney) in her fashionable apartment. On the trail of her murderer, McPherson quizzes Laura's arrogant best friend, gossip columnist Waldo Lydecker (Clifton Webb) and her comparatively mild fiancé, Shelby Carpenter (Vincent Price). As the detective grows obsessed with the case, he finds himself falling in love with the dead woman. (Mystery) - 1944

fxm.us.title: Lucy in the Sky
fxm.us.description: After an awe-inspiring experience in outer space, an astronaut returns to Earth and starts to lose touch with reality in a world that now seems too small. (Drama) - 2019

To the horror of his wife, Edie (Maria Bello), and teenage son, Jack (Ashton Holmes), Tom finds he must confront his violent past. (Drama, Thriller) - 2005

5starmax.us.title: The Usual Suspects

(Thriller, Crime drama) - 1995

With his former partner (Forest Whitaker) in hot pursuit, Remy runs for his life. (Science fiction, Action, Thriller) - 2010

But the detective gets a better idea. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 1984

Caesar displays unusual intelligence, and Will decides to continue his experiments secretly. But as Caesar's intellect and abilities grow, he comes to represent a threat to man's dominion over Earth. 5starmax.us.title: The Blair Witch Project

axstv.us.description: First forged in the '70s and '80s, Heartland Rock displays poetic, socially-conscious lyrics rooted in Americana. (Music) - 2024-10-21

axstv.us.title: Rock Legends - Mod
axstv.us.description: From the word modernist, Mod is a subculture that began in the late 1950s and spread throughout Great Britain, before ultimately influencing trends in other countries. Elements of the mod subculture include fashion, music (primarily jazz), and motor scooters. (Music) - 2024-10-22

axstv.us.title: Rock Legends - Punk Rock
axstv.us.description: See how rooted in the 1950s rock and roll and the 1960s garage rock, punk bands rejected the corporate nature of mainstream 1970s rock music, typically producing short, fast-paced songs with hard-edged melodies. (Music) - 2024-10-23

axstv.us.title: Rock Legends - 90s Riot Grrrl
axstv.us.description: An underground feminist punk movement that began during the early 1990s in Olympia, Wash.; it has since expanded to at least 26 other countries; combines feminism, punk music and politics. (Music) - 2024-10-28

axstv.us.title: A Year in Music - 2014
axstv.us.description: Halestorm's Lzzy Hale explores 2014; the Hall of Fame picks the top rockers of the year and Taylor Swift finds crossover success from country to pop; alternative rap gains momentum. (Music) - 2022-05-10

axstv.us.title: A Year in Music - 2011
axstv.us.description: Halestorm's Lzzy Hale explores the year 2011; saying goodbye to Amy Winehouse; musicians unite after two devastating storms hit the world; the end of the Iraq War. (Music) - 2020-11-22

axstv.us.title: A Year in Music - 2017
axstv.us.description: Renowned American singer Lzzy Hale takes a look at the music industry's chart toppers, trendsetters, award winners and headline makers of 2017. (Music) - 2021-06-20

bbcearth.us.title: Wild New Zealand
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E02 Wild Extremes The story of New Zealand's wildest places and its most resilient pioneers.

bbcearth.us.title: Wild New Zealand
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E03 New Arrivals The story of New Zealand's wildlife and its changing fortunes since the arrival of humans.

bbcearth.us.title: Wild Brazil
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E01 A Dangerous World Capuchin, giant otter and coatis babies take their first steps during a brief pause between seasonal extremes.

bbcearth.us.title: Wild Brazil
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E02 Facing the Flood The giant otters, coatis and capuchin monkeys have to learn how to survive as the river floods.

bbcearth.us.title: Wild Brazil
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E03 Enduring the Drought The monkeys, otters, coatis and jaguars battle to survive as drought and fires ravage the country.

bbcearth.us.title: Wild Mexico
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E01 Mountain Worlds The Serranías del Burro serves as a vital outpost for Mexico's black bears.

bbcearth.us.title: Mexico: Earth's Festival of Life
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E02 Forests of the Maya The ancient temples of the Maya still tower over the forests of the Yucatán, where jaguars, monkeys and tropical birds make their home; it is a forest full of secrets, with a vast watery underworld.

bbcearth.us.title: Wild Mexico
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E03 Burning North A feature on the forces behind Mexico's driest region, and the animals overcoming its conditions.

bbcearth.us.title: Animal Super Parents
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E01 Going It Alone Animal parents go the extra mile to arm the next generation with what they need to survive.

bbcearth.us.title: Animal Super Parents
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E02 It Takes two From penguins to cheetahs, parents protect and nurture their offspring through to adulthood.

bbcearth.us.title: Animal Super Parents
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E03 Lending a Hand Group parenting stories show why it's beneficial for animals to work as a team.

bbcearth.us.title: Animal Babies
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E01 Safari Babies The great plains of Africa are home to some of the most iconic animals on the planet. Growing up here means safari babies face immense challenges that will really test them.

bbcearth.us.title: Animal Babies
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E02 Water Babies Many animals that live in water come on land to have their babies. Being born this way presents some major challenges for water babies to overcome. For some, simply getting to water in the first place can be the biggest trial of their young lives.

bbcearth.us.title: Animal Babies
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E03 Mountain Babies Mountains are some of the most challenging places for animals to live. Mountain babies must battle extreme weather and hungry predators. With food difficult to find, they have to work hard for every mouthful.

bbcearth.us.title: Nature's Miracle Babies
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E01 Martin Hughes-Games travels to China where, without the extraordinary advances in reproductive science, the giant panda would be extinct.

bbcearth.us.title: Nature's Miracle Babies
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E02 Martin Hughes-Games investigates how captive breeding programs in zoos are hoping to increase the numbers of the rare Amur leopard.

bbcearth.us.title: Nature's Miracle Babies
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E03 Martin Hughes-Games investigates the problems that animals have when living on an island.

bbcearth.us.title: Nature's Miracle Babies
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E04 A rare baby parrot that has to be hand-fed; a newborn lemur clings to life; a tiny wallaby in need of a foster mom; 11 birds have to be taught how to migrate using a micro light.

bbcearth.us.title: Nature's Miracle Babies
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E05 Bald ibis chicks taught how to follow microlights as they fly back to freedom on a breathtaking migration over the Alps.

bbcearth.us.title: Nature's Miracle Orphans
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E01 In Australia, we meet Danny the baby Koala in need of round-the-clock care and Neil, a tiny orphaned Wallaby, whose caregiver Stella believes may die from stress if she can't find him a companion.

bbcearth.us.title: Nature's Miracle Orphans
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E02 Ellie meets a baby wombat with a big personality, and Newbie the baby three-toed sloth continues her battle with pneumonia and rehabilitation.

bbcearth.us.title: Nature's Miracle Orphans
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E03 Ellie Harrison and Max Hug Williams follow the stories of orphaned baby animals. This time, a clingy baby sloth, a baby bat and an orphaned kangaroo are cared for.

bbcearth.us.title: Nature's Miracle Orphans
bbcearth.us.description: S02 E01 Moyo & Robin Lucy meets Moyo, a baby elephant who must overcome his fear of water; Patrick meets Robin, an orphaned anteater who must prove he has the skills to survive in the wild.

bbcearth.us.title: Nature's Miracle Orphans
bbcearth.us.description: S02 E02 Monster & Africa An orphaned sloth must get through sloth boot camp before she can be released; Lucy helps African cats learn how to hunt.

bbcearth.us.title: Nature's Miracle Orphans
bbcearth.us.description: S02 E03 Santino & Shelley An orphaned baby monkey must find his place in a troop; Lucy helps a cheetah learn to hunt before she can be released back to the wild.

bbcearth.us.title: Nature's Miracle Orphans
bbcearth.us.description: S02 E04 Manji & Mandi An orphaned baby rhino learns how to be wild before he can be released; a baby tapir looks for a new family.

bbcearth.us.title: The Bear Family and Me
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E01 Spring Gordon Buchanan must overcome his own fear, black bears have a dangerous reputation and attack more people than any other bear in the world, but once he meets Lily, a tolerant bear, mother of Hope, Gordon feels heartbroken.

bbcearth.us.title: The Bear Family and Me
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E02 Summer Summer arrives and Gordon finds out that Tiny the bear cub has been abandoned by her mother.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Dish of the Day
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Unsung Heroes Nigel cooks haddock chowder, crumbed lamb steak with buttered Swede mash and fennel feta linguine.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Dish of the Day
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Do Yourself a Flavour Nigel introduces new flavor combinations that will reinvigorate our weekly shopping; ricotta beef burger, sesame seed salmon with miring and lemon and thyme cake.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Dish of the Day
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Simple Treats Nigel cooks seven delicious dishes, including chicken and leek pie, mushroom medley and raspberry and cinnamon meringue.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Dish of the Day
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 One Pan Wonders Nigel demonstrates that sometimes simple cookery is the best; herby artichoke stew, chicken in cider and compost crumble.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Dish of the Day
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Every Last Bit Nigel offers butternut squash soup with chips, rib ragout and cherry chocolate iced rice.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Dish of the Day
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Try Something Different Nigel shows how versatile ingredients in a weekly shop can be; duck and citrus salad, hot yogurt steak and chocolate beetroot cake.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Dish of the Day
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E08 When Nothing Else Will Do Nigel cooks up slow roast leg of lamb with herb rub and Parmesan mash, almond and lentil stew and tumbler trifle.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Dieppe Rick Stein embarks on a new journey through the byways of France, from the Channel to the Mediterranean, always on the lookout for things where the British could learn from the French to enhance lives.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Alsace and Jura Rick Stein goes through France's eastern border regions of Alsace and Jura home to his favorite French dish, choucroute garni and favorite French cheese, comté.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Burgundy Rick Stein continues exploring Burgundy and practices a little entente cordiale with a château owner who cooks him sorrel soup straight out of the garden.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Perigord Rick Stein arrives in the region of Perigord, famous for decadent dishes; he discovers his favorite market in the city of Perigueux and learns about the region's historical relationship with England as the former kingdom of Aquitaine.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Roussillon Rick Stein's journey of discovery brings him to the sunnier climes of the Mediterranean, where he explores the French-Catalan legacy of Roussillon on the foothills of the Pyrenees next to the Spanish border.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Languedoc Rick Stein approaches the end of his meander through France with a final glance at the culinary delights of the Languedoc before crossing over to Provence and the Mediterranean coastline that reveals new insights into southern French cuisine.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein From Venice to Istanbul
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Rick's journey begins in the magnificent city of Venice and on the idyllic Greek island of Symi he cooks some of his favorite Venetian dishes: seafood risotto, tiramisu and gnocchi with spider crab.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein From Venice to Istanbul
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Rick Stein continues his gastronomic journey from Venice to Istanbul; in the Byzantine city of Ravenna he discovers Piadinas, street food dating back to Roman times.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein From Venice to Istanbul
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Rick Stein continues his Byzantine odyssey through Croatia and savours the famous native oysters of Ston; he then crosses the border to Albania, a country loved by Lord Byron.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein From Venice to Istanbul
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Rick Stein's gastronomic journey from Venice to Istanbul brings him to Northern Greece and the historic city of Ioannina where he tastes a traditional Veal Stifado and Kotopita.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein From Venice to Istanbul
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Rick Stein arrives in the Greek Peloponnese and samples memorable dishes like rooster stew hilopites with mizithra cheese and the best home-made moussaka he's ever had; in his Symi island kitchen, he cooks galaktoboureko.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein From Venice to Istanbul
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Turkey Rick Stein's journey from Venice to Istanbul is nearing its completion as he leaves southern Greece for the shores of Western Turkey.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein From Venice to Istanbul
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Rick Stein's culinary odyssey ends in the legendary city of Istanbul where he enjoys a fishing expedition on the Bosphorus and cooks lavish kofte kebabs with pistachios.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 San Francisco to Monterey Rick enjoys sitting on the dock of the bay in San Francisco, tasting legendary dishes like the hangtown fry; San Francisco is also the home of sourdough and where America's love affair with seasonal cooking took hold.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Monterey to San Diego Rick Stein continues traveling down the Californian coastline immortalized by Steinbeck.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 San Diego to Baja California Rick enjoys a hearty steak and eggs American diner special and bids a fond farewell to his trusty Ford Mustang as he heads across what is reputed to be the busiest border crossing in the world.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Guadalajara to Puerto Vallarta Rick lands in the town that gave the world tequila and the metropolis that birthed mariachis and dishes like chili con carne.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Mexico City to Oaxaca Rick Stein visits the Mexican capital to sample the Aztec cuisine.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Oaxaca to Chinantlan Mountains Rick Stein's latest travels take him to Mexico's culinary capital Oaxaca.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Oaxaca to Yucatan Peninsula Rick Stein heads east from Oaxaca to the Yucatán Peninsula, a place once frequented by real pirates of the Caribbean, including Sir Francis Drake.

bbcfood.us.title: Hairy Bikers' Bakeation
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Norway The Hairy Bikers head to Kristiansund on the coast of Norway to meet specialist artisan bakers.

bbcfood.us.title: Hairy Bikers' Bakeation
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Low Countries Dave and Si journey through the Netherlands, where they bake lazybones buns beside a windmill.

bbcfood.us.title: Hairy Bikers' Bakeation
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Germany The guys travel from the wine region of the Rhine Valley to the spiritual home of beer, Bavaria, and discover Germany's passion for bread of every shape, size and flavor.

bbcfood.us.title: Hairy Bikers' Bakeation
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Eastern Europe The Hairy Bikers travel to the furthest corners of Europe, culminating in a fun family party thrown by Dave's Romanian wife, Lil.

bbcfood.us.title: Hairy Bikers' Bakeation
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Austria The bikers tour the home of Mozart and Arnold Schwarzenegger, starting in the pâtisserie capital of the world, Vienna.

bbcfood.us.title: Hairy Bikers' Bakeation
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Italy The bikers abandon their bikes in favor of gondolas and cook up focaccia, stromboli and eat a pasta pie on the backstreets of Ferrara.

bbcfood.us.title: Hairy Bikers' Bakeation
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 France In Lyon, Dave and Si explore the 'bouchon', a restaurant normally run by a female chef.

bbcfood.us.title: Hairy Bikers' Bakeation
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E08 Spain Dave and Si journey through Spain and visit a traditional Basque dining club in San Sebastián.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Chocolate Chef Raymond Blanc creates four mouth-watering chocolate recipes: a simple mousse, rich chocolate delice, fondant with a melting middle, and his signature dessert: café crème, which is a chocolate-sculpted cup filled with a mousse and coffee sabayon.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Apples Chef Raymond Blanc looks to the UK's favorite fruit, apples, for inspiration; he returns to memories of childhood with a simple tart made with a foolproof pastry and custard filling.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Winter Vegetables Chef Blanc celebrates the season with a winter vegetable salad featuring beetroots, a celeriac purée served with a crisp-skinned roast wild duck with blackberry sauce and watercress soup.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Game and Mushrooms Chef Blanc uses two seasonal ingredients, game and mushrooms, to create a French version of a pasty called pithivier, which is filled with a rich mix of pheasant, chestnuts and dried fruits; he also makes a cep mushroom tortellini with fresh pasta.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Bread The miracle of yeast helps Raymond to create a French classic: brioche; he gets down to basics with a French country bread recipe that's essential for any baker to add to their repertoire; lastly, he makes a spectacular apple croustade.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E02 Cakes and Pastries Chef Raymond begins with a feather-light lemon tea cake, coated in an apricot jam and tangy lemon glaze; he also makes a choux pastry filled with chocolate cream and covered with a chocolate icing; lastly, the secrets to the perfect macarons.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E03 Lamb Chef Blanc shares his favorite lamb dishes: lamb liver with caramelized potatoes and French seasoning, a slow-roasted garlic and herb lamb shoulder with potato and turnip gratin and lamb Provencal with ratatouille.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E04 Pudding Raymond celebrates his passion for puddings, cooking dishes including riz au lait, tarte tatin and fruit crumble.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Suppers
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Leftovers Nigel starts off with the remains of the Sunday roast.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Suppers
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Winter Warmers Nigel makes comfort foods that hit the spot.

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

cinevault.us.title: All the King's Men
cinevault.us.description: Charismatic Southern politician Willie Stark's (Sean Penn) idealism and good intentions give way to corruption after he becomes governor of Louisiana. Unfortunately for Stark, his right-hand man (Jude Law) retains the same good moral fiber he had when the men both entered the political arena. (Drama, Movie) - 2006-09-22

cinevault.us.title: Guarding Tess
cinevault.us.description: Doug Chesnic (Nicolas Cage), an agent with the Secret Service Uniformed Division, is assigned to protect former first lady Tess Carlisle (Shirley MacLaine). Chesnic finds the job demeaning and a challenge because of Tess' high-maintenance personality and petty demands. He's desperate to get another assignment, but she insists that he remain head of her security detail, using her influence with the current president to get her way. When she's kidnapped, however, Chesnic's feelings change. (Comedy drama, Movie) - 1994-04-30

cinevault.us.title: Robot and Frank
cinevault.us.description: An aging, cantankerous ex-cat burglar finds his zest for life renewed when he trains his robotic caretaker to help him commit heists. (Comedy drama, Movie, Science fiction) - 2012-01-20

cinevault.us.title: The Principal
cinevault.us.description: The new principal (James Belushi) of a drug-infested high school joins with a security guard (Louis Gossett Jr.) to clean it up. (Comedy drama, Movie) - 1987

cinevault.us.title: Desperate Measures
cinevault.us.description: Widowed cop Frank Conner (Andy Garcia) is determined to secure a bone marrow transplant for his son, Matt (Joseph Cross), who will die of leukemia if a suitable donor isn't found. Conner discovers that incarcerated serial murderer Peter McCabe (Michael Keaton) is a match for Matt, and the psychopath eventually agrees to donate marrow, but he escapes from the operating room just before the procedure. Conner quickly follows, but the scheming McCabe won't be easily apprehended. (Movie, Thriller) - 1997

cinevault.us.title: Gloria
cinevault.us.description: After serving three years in prison covering for her gangster boyfriend, Kevin (Jeremy Northam), Gloria (Sharon Stone) returns to New York City for the money she was promised. Inside Kevin's base of operations, she finds 7-year-old Nicky (Jean-Luke Figueroa), whose family has been killed. Nicky is hanging onto a computer disk that incriminates the gang. Kevin refuses to pay Gloria, so she steals Nicky and the evidence. On the run in the city, the cynical ex-convict and the young boy grow close. (Crime drama, Movie) - 1999-05-25

cinevault.us.title: Crossroads
cinevault.us.description: A guitar student (Ralph Macchio) tours the Deep South with an old blues man (Joe Seneca), chasing a lost song written by Robert Johnson. (Drama, Movie, Music, Romance) - 1986

cinevault.us.title: White Water Summer
cinevault.us.description: An experienced wilderness guide, Vic (Kevin Bacon) leads a group of teenagers from the city on their first big outdoor adventure. One of the boys, the sheltered and defiant Alan (Sean Astin), resents Vic's tough attempts at teaching them life lessons and clashes with him. After tensions have built up between Vic and his young charges, he is injured in an incident and needs their help so that they all can survive the ordeal and make it back to civilization. (Adventure, Movie) - 1987

cinevault.us.title: Final Descent
cinevault.us.description: A pilot (Robert Urich) and co-pilot (Annette O'Toole) have limited options to land a jumbo jet after a severe midair collision. (Movie, Thriller) - 1997-10-12

cinevault.us.title: Final Run
cinevault.us.description: A man (Robert Urich) tries to stop a computerized train that is speeding out of control and headed for a large hospital. (Drama, Movie) - 1999-10-10

cinevault.us.title: Miracle on the Mountain: The Kincaid Family Story
cinevault.us.description: Injured when their private plane crashes into a snowy mountain, a domineering man (William Devane) and his family (Patty Duke, Elisabeth Rosen) face an avalanche and bitter winds. (Drama, Movie) - 2000-04-26

cinevault.us.title: Awakenings
cinevault.us.description: The story of a doctor's extraordinary work in the Sixties with a group of catatonic patients he finds languishing in a Bronx hospital. Speculating that their rigidity may be akin to an extreme form of Parkinsonism, he seeks permission from his skeptical superiors to treat them with L-dopa, a drug that was used to treat Parkinson's disease at the time. (Biography, Drama, Movie) - 1990-12-20

cinevault.us.title: Julie & Julia
cinevault.us.description: Frustrated with a soul-killing job, New Yorker Julie Powell embarks on a daring project: she vows to prepare all 524 recipes in Julia Child's landmark cookbook, "Mastering the Art of French Cooking." Intertwined with Julie's story is the true tale of how Julia Child herself conquered French cuisine with passion, fearlessness, and plenty of butter. (Comedy drama, Movie) - 2009-08-07

cinevault.us.title: Eat Pray Love
cinevault.us.description: Liz Gilbert (Julia Roberts) thought she had everything she wanted in life: a home, a husband and a successful career. Now newly divorced and facing a turning point, she finds that she is confused about what is important to her. Daring to step out of her comfort zone, Liz embarks on a quest of self-discovery that takes her to Italy, India and Bali. (Drama, Movie, Romance) - 2010-08-13

cinevault.us.title: Brian's Song
cinevault.us.description: Although they both play for the Chicago Bears, Brian Piccolo (Sean Maher) is white, a joker and mostly rides the bench while Gale Sayers (Mekhi Phifer) is black, serious and a rookie superstar. Neither likes the other much, but when coach Halas (Ben Gazzara) makes them the first interracial roommates in the NFL, the two gradually form a sincere friendship. Piccolo helps Sayers overcome an injury, and Sayers later gives Piccolo much needed support when he's diagnosed with terminal cancer. (Docudrama, Movie) - 2001-12-02

cinevault.us.title: The Nines
cinevault.us.description: Three actors (Ryan Reynolds, Hope Davis, Melissa McCarthy) tackle the principal roles in a trio of stories. In "The Prisoner," a publicist and a neighbor are the only links to the outside world for an actor under house arrest. "Reality Television" charts the production of a TV sitcom. In "Knowing," a video-game designer and his family are stranded in the forest after their car breaks down. (Drama, Movie) - 2007-01-21

cinevault.us.title: Agnes of God
cinevault.us.description: Dr. Martha Livingston (Jane Fonda) is a court-appointed psychiatrist sent to evaluate Sister Agnes (Meg Tilly), a young nun whose infant has been found strangled. With Agnes claiming a virgin conception and having no memory of giving birth, Livingston must distinguish between the lies and the nun's perception-altering faith. Complicating her investigation, Livingston continually clashes with the overbearing Mother Miriam Ruth (Anne Bancroft), who insists that Livingston leave Agnes alone. (Drama, Movie) - 1985-09-13

cinevault.us.title: Touch the Top of the World
cinevault.us.description: Climber Erik Weihenmayer becomes the first blind person to reach the summit of Mount Everest. (Docudrama, Movie) - 2006-06-11

cinevault.us.title: Buddy
cinevault.us.description: Thanks to the indulgence of her patient husband, Dr. Bill Lintz, wealthy eccentric Trudy has already accumulated a large collection of wild animals by 1931 when she is introduced to Buddy, a sickly young gorilla. Trudy raises Buddy as her own child, dressing him in human clothes, and the ape responds with absolute obedience. But as Buddy grows older and larger, Trudy is unable to restrain him from turning increasingly violent. (Adventure, Children, Comedy drama, Movie) - 1997-06-06

cinevault.us.title: The Master of Disguise
cinevault.us.description: Pistachio Disguisey, a genial waiter at his father Fabrizio's Italian restaurant, possesses an uncanny knack for mimicry. What he doesn't know is that his talent is genetic, and that he is the descendant of a long line of Masters of Disguise, all of whom have inherited the secret family gift known as Energico. Initially, Pistachio is a klutz, but little by little, he learns to harness his inherited power, and sallies forth to utilize Energico to its fullest. (Comedy, Movie) - 2002-08-02

cinevault.us.title: Sunset
cinevault.us.description: Having retired from a life of gunfights and peacekeeping, the great Wyatt Earp (James Garner) has landed a job as adviser to a Western movie about himself. On the set of the silent picture, he gets to know Tom Mix (Bruce Willis), an actor who specializes in Westerns, who has been hired to portray Earp. Not long after making each others' acquaintance, they find out that Earp's ex-girlfriend's son is missing, and the man responsible may be studio chief Alfie Alperin (Malcolm McDowell). (Comedy drama, Movie) - 1988-04-29

cinevault.us.title: Conspiracy
cinevault.us.description: A former Marine (Val Kilmer) brings justice to a small town after his friend mysteriously disappears. (Action, Movie, Thriller) - 2008-02-15

cinevault.us.title: No Mercy
cinevault.us.description: After his partner is killed by the merciless crime boss Losado, Chicago cop Eddie Jillette takes to New Orleans to settle the score. When he finds Losado's mistress, Michel, Eddie handcuffs himself to the girl and heads for the bayou in an effort to draw out his rival. And though squatting in a swamp handcuffed to another person is no recipe for romance, Eddie and Michel soon find themselves falling in love even as Losado is closing in. cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Sufganiyot (Hanukkah jelly doughnuts); the importance of schmaltz in Jewish cuisine; leave-in temperature probes; cast iron potato kugel.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Cook's Country - Celebrating Springtime
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Pomegranate-glazed grilled lamb chops; radishes; asparagus salad with radishes.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Julia at Home - Cozy Wintertime Brunch
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Egg roulade; roasted potatoes; rosemary olive biscuits; spicy tomato jam.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Julia at Home - Chili for a Crowd
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Julia cooks her favorite beef chili with black beans and chipotle, easy baked white rice, and watermelon-lime agua fresca.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Julia at Home - Grill Roasted Chicken for Dinner
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Chicken on the grill; black-eyed pea salad with peaches; white wine sangria; nectarine and blackberry galette.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Cook's Country - Chips on the Menu
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Frito pie; a tasting of nonalcoholic beer; the story of the Potato Chip Queen of the West; chocolate-dipped potato chip cookies.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Cook's Country - Classic Cookout
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Blueberry cream pie; the rarity of blue foods in nature; travel utensil sets; sweet tea-brined fried chicken.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Julia at Home - Clambake in the Burbs
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Julia celebrates with an indoor clambake made with fresh lobster, mussels, and clams, served with honey cornbread and bistro slaw.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Julia at Home - Cozy Dinner for Two
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Julia serves broiled oysters and mini shepherd's pies with apple fennel salad. Apple strudel is for dessert.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Julia at Home - Family-Style Italian Sunday Supper
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Cheesy arancini; short rib ragù; arugula and fig salad; pistachio cannoli.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Cook's Country - Sausages and Salad
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Choucroute garnie; Belgian endive; European-style sausages; endive salad with oranges and blue cheese.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Cook's Country - Chuck Roast and Potatoes
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Roasted beef chuck roast with horseradish parsley sauce; medicinal uses for horseradish; kitchen timers; torn and fried potatoes; creamed spinach.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Cook's Country - Biscuits and Chicken
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Butter and lard biscuits; the debate between lard and shortening; the benefits of full-sized and mini food processors; mimosa fried chicken.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Julia at Home - Summer Supper With Friends
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Grilled chicken; buttery grilled corn; Parmesan orzo salad; lemon pie.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Julia at Home - Favorite Fried Chicken
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Julia whips up her favorite fried chicken with slow-cooker buttermilk smashed potatoes, and quick collard greens with hot pepper vinegar.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Julia at Home - Chili With Cheesy Scones for a Crowd
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Black bean chili; jalapeño-cheddar scones; salad with orange vinaigrette; slow-cooker flan.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Cook's Country - Thanksgiving, Simplified
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: One-pan turkey breast and stuffing; dressing vs. stuffing debate; buying turkey; pear-cranberry chutney; roasted butternut squash and apple.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Cook's Country - Italian Comfort Food
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Cheesy stuffed shells; 13x9 broiler-safe baking dishes; eggplant pecorino.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Cook's Country - Italian-American Comforts
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Italian meatloaf; substitutes for fresh garlic; asparagus baked in foil; immigrant origins of scampi; chicken scampi.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Cook's Country - Bread, Cheese and Meat Can't Be Beat
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Sliders; ketchup; croque monsieur.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Julia at Home - Back to School Dinner
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Julia welcomes the start of the school year with one-pan, twin roast chickens plus root vegetables with tarragon vinaigrette and butterscotch pudding for dessert.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Julia at Home - Cast Iron: Morning, Noon and Night
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Julia makes everything in a cast iron from strata, paninis, teriyaki-style chicken thighs and apple fritters.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Julia at Home - Vegetarian Feast
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Stuffed portabello mushrooms; lemon and basil pasta; apple and radicchio salad; almond cake.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Cook's Country - Elevated Friendsgiving Mains
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Slow-roasted duck with blackberry sauce; the best uses for different tinned fish; a rich bean bourguignon.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Cook's Country - Short Ribs and Baked Potatoes
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Slow-roasted medium rare beef short ribs; beef steaks; a fun baked potato story; twice-baked potatoes with bacon and cheddar cheese.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Cook's Country - New England Sandwiches
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Jitto's-style steak bombs; types of squash; the origins of different sandwich names; eggplant spuckie.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Cook's Country - Darn Good Desserts
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: S'mores pie; rolling pins; M&M cookies.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Julia at Home - Comfort Food With a Twist
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Julia's take on comfort food includes thick-cut pork chops with smoked sea salt, garlic-scented mashed sweet potatoes with coconut milk and cilantro, a brussels sprouts and kale salad with herbs and peanuts, and her slow-cooker Nutella bread pudding.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Julia at Home - Davison House Burgers
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: It's burger night in the Davison house and Julia's got all the fixings: home ground beef, crispy home fries, and her all-time favorite condiment, homemade pickled onions.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Julia at Home - Chilaquiles for a Crowd
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Julia's weekend plans include her favorite cast-iron chicken chilaquiles with homemade hot sauce, refreshing micheladas, and restaurant-inspired fried ice cream cake.

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Julia at Home
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Julia Collin Davison cooks in her home kitchen; she whips up test kitchen favorites and cooks from some of her recipe books, breathing new life into long-standing traditions. (Cooking, Educational) - 2020-12-31

cook'scountrychannel.us.title: Cook's Country
cook'scountrychannel.us.description: Hosts Bridget Lancaster, Julia Collin Davison and Toni Tipton-Martin offer a practical, no-nonsense and scientific approach to making a wide range of American recipes, from barbecue chicken thighs to Mississippi mud pie to parmesan potatoes. The hosts are joined by test cooks Morgan Bolling, Lawman Johnson, Christie Morrison, Ashley Moore, Bryan Roof and Kelly Song. Episodes include equipment recommendations for the home cook, taste tests and regional recipes such as coastal Georgia paella and mesquite-grilled tacos rasurados. (Cooking) - 2014-08-30

cozitv.us.title: The King of Queens - Apartment Complex
cozitv.us.description: Doug and the guys secretly rent an apartment above their favorite Chinese restaurant; Carrie goes to extremes to keep her newest client, Kirstie Alley, happy.

cozitv.us.title: The King of Queens - Raygin' Bulls
cozitv.us.description: When Carrie goes on a trip with her father, Doug and his friend (Ray Romano) plan a guys night on the town.

cozitv.us.title: Two and a Half Men - Always a Bridesmaid, Never a Burro
cozitv.us.description: Charlie sleeps with Kandi's mother, as Alan tries to win her daughter back; Kandi arranges a date between her father and Judith.

cozitv.us.title: Two and a Half Men - And the Plot Moistens
cozitv.us.description: Alan finds that he has more in common with Jake's teacher than with Kandi; Charlie helps Jake prepare a song for his audition for the school musical.

cozitv.us.title: Two and a Half Men - Just Once With Aunt Sophie
cozitv.us.description: Charlie and Alan help Jake prepare for his first boy-girl party.

cozitv.us.title: Two and a Half Men - Arguments for the Quickie
cozitv.us.description: Charlie's former girlfriend (Emmanuelle Vaugier) returns with an unexpected request.

cozitv.us.title: George Lopez - Bringing Home the Bacon
cozitv.us.description: Angie begins to make plans for Carmen's expensive birthday party despite George's efforts to put his foot down.

cozitv.us.title: George Lopez - Fishing Cubans
cozitv.us.description: George, Ernie and Vic go to sea to rescue Angie's uncle after he escapes from Cuba by raft; Max throws himself a birthday party.

cozitv.us.title: George Lopez - Mementos
cozitv.us.description: George, who's preparing to give a kidney to his father, is in trouble with Angie because he threw away a box of her family mementos, but both their priorities shift when Benny delivers bad news: Manny has died.

filmriseaction.us.title: In Hell

filmriseaction.us.title: Derailed

filmriseaction.us.title: Eye See You

filmriseaction.us.title: Mercenary for Justice
filmriseaction.us.description: A soldier of fortune (Steven Seagal) seeks revenge after staging a daring jailbreak and being double-crossed. - 2006

filmriseaction.us.title: Arlington Road
filmriseaction.us.description: Widowed when his FBI agent wife is killed by an extremist group, college professor Michael Faraday (Jeff Bridges) becomes obsessed with the culture of these groups -- especially when his new all-American neighbors, Oliver (Tim Robbins) and Cheryl Lang (Joan Cusack), start acting suspiciously. With each twist, the mystery deepens and questions loom whether Faraday is consumed by fear and driven by paranoia, or whether a lethal conspiracy has been born on Arlington Road. (Thriller, Crime drama, Action, Mystery, Adventure) - 1999

filmriseaction.us.title: JCVD
filmriseaction.us.description: Weary action star Jean-Claude Van Damme (Jean-Claude Van Damme) returns to Belgium to find relief from his troubles but instead stumbles into a bank robbery. (Comedy, Crime drama, Action) - 2008

filmriseaction.us.title: Operator
filmriseaction.us.description: When the daughter of a dispatcher and a cop is kidnapped, they are forced to follow the kidnapper's rules and have to choose to save their daughter or the city. (Action, Drama, Thriller) - 2015

filmriseaction.us.title: K-19: The Widowmaker
filmriseaction.us.description: Follows Captain Alexei Vostrikov who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men. (Thriller, Historical drama, War) - 2002

filmriseaction.us.title: Freejack
filmriseaction.us.description: Early in the 21st century, technological advances have made it possible for aging, wealthy people to pay crooks like Vacendak (Mick Jagger) to go back in time, kidnap young victims like race car driver Alex Furlong (Emilio Estevez) and deliver them to the elderly clients, who then have their brains transplanted into the healthy bodies. Furlong manages to break free from his captors, but as a fugitive, he finds that the world of the future is a bleak, dangerous place. (Science fiction) - 1992

filmriseaction.us.title: The Contract
filmriseaction.us.description: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire. (Thriller) - 2006

filmriseaction.us.title: Assault on Precinct 13
filmriseaction.us.description: When the LAPD kills several members of the South Central gang Street Thunder, the remaining members avenge themselves by way of a bloody war waged against cops and citizens alike. Caught in the crossfire is Lt. Ethan Bishop (Austin Stoker), who's managing a skeleton crew at the local and soon-to-be-closed police precinct. As the gang members close in, Bishop forms an unlikely alliance with a group of prisoners in order to defend the station and the lives of everyone in it. (Action) - 1976

filmriseaction.us.title: Dillinger and Capone

filmriseaction.us.title: Gunfight at Rio Bravo
filmriseaction.us.description: A mysterious Russian gunslinger aids a marshal and a sheriff in a standoff with an outlaw gang who have invaded their town. (Western) - 2023

filmriseaction.us.title: Blitz

Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew. (Western, Action) - 2003

Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). logo.us.title: Mama's Family - A Blast From the Past

logo.us.title: Mama's Family - Psychic Pheno-Mama

logo.us.title: Mama's Family - Take My Mama, Please!

retroplex.us.title: The Carson City Kid
retroplex.us.description: The Carson City Kid (Roy Rogers) stops stagecoaches traveling between Wild West mining towns, searching their mail sacks for letters addressed to Morgan Reynolds, the man who killed his brother. Discovering that Reynolds operates a saloon under the name Lee Jessup (Bob Steele), the Kid takes a job as the saloon's bouncer. While vying with Reynolds for the affections of singer Joby Madison (Pauline Moore), the Kid discovers a swindled miner (Noah Beery Jr.) who claims to be the Carson City Kid. (Western) - 1940

retroplex.us.title: Lights of Old Santa Fe
retroplex.us.description: In this musical western, Marjorie Brooks (Dale Evans) is the owner and operator of a rodeo that's an antiquated touring company on its last legs. Her business rival, Frank Madden (Richard Powers), offers to combine their operations if the lovely Marjorie will be his bride. Though she initially rebuffs his proposal, a canceled booking tips the scales and forces Marjorie to accept. But rodeo rider Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) suspects Frank is behind Marjorie's troubles and sets out to investigate. (Western) - 1944

retroplex.us.title: Robin Hood of the Pecos
retroplex.us.description: A night rider (George "Gabby" Hayes) and his singing partner (Roy Rogers) send Texas carpetbaggers packing. (Western) - 1941

retroplex.us.title: The Trail Beyond
retroplex.us.description: Fresh out of college, American Rod Drew (John Wayne) is asked to assist in the search for missing people in Canada. Accompanied by Wabi (Noah Beery Jr.), his friend from school, Drew travels north, but quickly gets into a confrontation with a gang of French Canadian outlaws. When the bandits abduct the young Felice Newsome (Verna Hillie), it becomes apparent they're responsible for the other disappearances as well. Luckily, Drew and Wabi are there, determined to find and free the captives. (Western) - 1934

retroplex.us.title: The Cowboy and the Senorita
retroplex.us.description: Things go from bad to worse for singing cowboy Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) and his trusty companion, Teddy Bear (Guinn "Big Boy" Williams), when, after losing their jobs at a local café, the pair are accused of having kidnapped young Chip Williams (Mary Lee) who, in reality, is merely a runaway who's been tagging along with the cowpokes. But amidst these problems, Roy and his partner decide to team up with the girl and her half-sister, Ysobel (Dale Evans), and search for some long-buried treasure. (Western) - 1944

retroplex.us.title: Sagebrush Trail
retroplex.us.description: Wrongly imprisoned for murder, John Brant (John Wayne) decides his only option is to escape from jail and clear his name by finding the true killer. After breaking out, he ends up on the run from Sheriff Parker (Bob Burns) and catches the attention of outlaw Bob Jones (Lane Chandler), who offers to let Brant into his gang. Needing all the help he can get, Brant agrees, but running with these bandits only gets him deeper into trouble -- while the real killer remains on the loose. (Western) - 1933

retroplex.us.title: Outlaws of the Plains
retroplex.us.description: An impressionable cowpoke, Fuzzy Q. Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), hears a voice claiming to be that of an old Native American, telling him the location of some hidden gold. Fuzzy does find gold, but the land has already been claimed by Nord Finner (Charles King Jr.). Finner offers to sell his claim, and Fuzzy is eager to buy. Then Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe), a friend of Fuzzy's, shows up and discovers that a gang of outlaws is behind a scheme to rob everyone in the area. (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: Romance of the West
retroplex.us.description: Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean), along with his sidekick, Ezra (Emmett Lynn), oversees the peaceful coexistence of the Native American tribes with the white settlers of Antelope Valley. The treaty that binds the two groups is threatened when some of the town leaders learn that the Native American land contains rich deposits of silver. Eager to oust the tribes and claim the silver, the town leaders try to provoke an attack that would break the treaty. It's up to Eddie to stop them in time. (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: Panhandle
retroplex.us.description: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown. (Western) - 1948

retroplex.us.title: Border Feud
retroplex.us.description: A feud has broken out over control of a Nevada gold mine, and Sheriff Fuzzy Q. Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) realizes that he needs a steady hand by his side. Good thing Fuzzy is pals with Cheyenne Davis (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), an out-of-towner who specializes in fighting crime. Beckoned by Fuzzy, Cheyenne arrives just as local beauty Carol Condon (Gloria Marlen) is taken captive by one of the warring parties. Cheyenne and Fuzzy will have to act fast in order to free her and defuse the tension. (Western) - 1947

retroplex.us.title: Paradise Canyon
retroplex.us.description: Rough-and-tumble federal agent John Wyatt (John Wayne) receives an unusual undercover assignment: He must infiltrate the ranks of an Arizona-based medicine show. Wyatt's boss suspects the show's shifty-eyed proprietor, ex-convict Dr. Carter (Earle Hodgins), of running a massive counterfeiting operation. With the full cooperation of the local authorities, Wyatt poses as a sharpshooter and begins his investigation -- only to fall for Carter's beautiful daughter, Linda (Marion Burns). (Western) - 1935

retroplex.us.title: The Cowboy and the Indians
retroplex.us.description: Rancher Gene Autry tries to aid neighboring Navajos suffering from malnutrition, but he is opposed by a crafty and crooked trading post proprietor. (Western) - 1949

retroplex.us.title: Under California Stars
retroplex.us.description: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom. (Western) - 1948

retroplex.us.title: Jericho
retroplex.us.description: Jericho (Mark Valley) wakes up with no memory, but it's apparent that he's quite skilled with a gun. He is befriended by Joshua (Leon Coffee), who appears to be his polar opposite: He's a black man and true believer in the Lord, whereas Jericho is white and doubtful of everything, especially himself. Side by side, they attempt to piece together the amnesiac's past, which may or may not have something to do with a robbery, and either way is somehow connected to a town that's also called Jericho. (Western, Mystery) - 2000

retroplex.us.title: Chappaquiddick
retroplex.us.description: On July 18, 1969, Sen. Ted Kennedy drives his car off of a bridge on Massachusetts' Chappaquiddick Island. The accident results in the death of passenger Mary Jo Kopechne, a 28-year-old campaign strategist who worked for Kennedy. The ongoing investigation into the mysterious events forever alters his political legacy and changes the course of presidential history. (Thriller, Historical drama) - 2017

retroplex.us.title: Niagara Niagara
retroplex.us.description: Two misfits (Robin Tunney, Henry Thomas) meet while shoplifting and set out on a mission that takes a quick downward spiral. (Drama) - 1997

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Build That?

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Build That?

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Build That?

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Build That?

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Build That?

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Build That?

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S04E06 Tunnel Vision Mike joins crews as they build the world's longest railway tunnel in the Alps, fixing gridlock through the infamous Brenner Pass by drilling, blasting and digging their way through the mountains.

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S04E08 For-Everglades Mike works with the Army Corps of Engineers on a massive project to restore essential flow of fresh water to the Florida Everglades; he also joins scientists, python hunters and the Miccosukee Tribe to eliminate invasive species in these wetlands.

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S02E03 Aquarius Reef Base Diving into retrofits on the world's only underwater habitat, where NASA astronauts train for space missions; Mike joins a crack repair team who breathe new life into this oceanic environment after a global pandemic shut it down.

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S05E01 Afterburn In Southern California, crews rebuild after the 2025 wildfires, cutting firebreaks, repairing emergency water systems, hardening roads and power lines and building fire-resistant homes before the next firestorm.

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S03E01 US Coast Guard: Safeguarding The Seas Mike helps fix the vessels that the U.S. Coast Guard use to keep the oceans safe; he replaces key parts of ship engines, removes a large crane from a buoy tender, and fixes a helicopter for a critical exercise.

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S02E01 Powerships Mike Davidson heads to Brazil, where an offshore crew is racing the clock to set up giant power ships to deliver electricity to a country in desperate need.

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: How Did They Fix That?

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Combat Ships

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Combat Ships

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Combat Ships

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Combat Ships

classica.us.title: In der Probe: - Zubin Mehta
classica.us.description: Der indische Dirigent Zubin Mehta wurde 1977 Musikdirektor des Israel Philharmonic Orchestra ernannt. Ein intimer Blick wird auf den Dialog zwischen Mehta und den Mitgliedern des Orchesters geworfen, während sie Strauss' Tondichtung proben.

classica.us.title: Verdi - Rigoletto
classica.us.description: Riccardo Frizza dirigiert das Orchester und den Chor des Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in einer Aufführung der tragischen Oper "Rigoletto" von Giuseppe Verdi. Diese Aufführung wurde 2021 im Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florenz aufgezeichnet.

classica.us.title: Schumann - 2. Klaviersonate in g-Moll, op. 22
classica.us.description: In dieser Aufführung präsentiert Riccardo Schwartz Schumanns Klaviersonate Nr. 2 in g-Moll, Op. 22. Es beginnt mit einem energischen ersten Satz, gefolgt von einem wunderschönen, langsamen Andantino nach Schumanns Lied "Im Herbste".

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern.

classica.us.title: Beethoven - 1. Klavierkonzert, Op. 15
classica.us.description: Lars Vogt ist Solist in einer Aufführung von Beethovens erstem Klavierkonzert. Das Orchestre de Paris wird von Herbert Blomstedt dirigiert. Die Aufnahme entstand 2013 im Salle Pleyel in Paris.

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Streichquartette Nr. 2, 14 und 16
classica.us.description: Das Quatuor Ébène präsentiert in der Philharmonie de Paris Meisterwerke aus Beethovens Streichquartettrepertoire. Zum Jubiläum des Komponisten spielt das renommierte französische Ensemble die Streichquartette Nr. 2, 14 und 16.

classica.us.title: Mendelssohn - Trio No. 1 Op. 49
classica.us.description: Martha Argerich spielt in diesem Konzert Mendelssohns Klaviertrio Nr. 1 in d-Moll. Anlässlich ihres 80. Geburtstags widmete sich die argentinische Pianistin bei diesem Konzert im Château de Chantilly dem Kammermusikrepertoire.

classica.us.title: Heavenly Voices - Farinellis Vermächtnis
classica.us.description: Als "Kastraten" werden männliche Sänger bezeichnet, die mit glockenklarer Stimme Tonhöhen des Soprans erreichen können. In diesem Dokumentarfilm gehen die Filmemacher unter anderem dem Phänomen der Kastraten auf den Grund. - 2012

classica.us.title: Saint-Saëns - Polonaise für zwei Klaviere Op. 77
classica.us.description: Anlässlich ihres 80. Geburtstags spielt Martha Argerich Saint-Saëns Polonaise für Klavier Op. 77. Das Konzert wurde im Château de Chantilly, Frankreich, aufgezeichnet. Die Pianistin wird von verschiedenen renommierten Künstlern begleitet.

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern.

classica.us.title: Schönheit ist ein Verbrechen: Mendelssohn & Brahms
classica.us.description: Teodor Currentzis dirigiert sein Musikensemble MusicAeterna und die Violinspielerin Patricia Kopatchinskaja in einem Konzertprogramm. Thema ist die Suche nach einer neuen Definition von Schönheit. Brahms und Mendelssohn werden in neues Licht gerückt.

classica.us.title: In der Probe: - Mariss Jansons
classica.us.description: Mariss Jansons probt mit dem Oslo Philharmonischen Orchester die kraftvolle Suite aus Béla Bartóks Pantomimenballett "Der wunderbare Mandarin", gefolgt von einer Aufführung des gleichen Stücks aus dem Konzerthaus von Oslo.

classica.us.title: Mozart - Requiem in d-Moll, K. 626
classica.us.description: Daniel Harding dirigiert das Orchester und den Chor des Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in dieser Aufführung von Wolfgang Amadeus Mozarts Requiem in d-Moll. Die Solisten sind Christiane Karg, Sara Mingardo, Matthew Swensen und Gianluca Buratto.

classica.us.title: Beethoven - - 5. Klavierkonzert, Op. 73
classica.us.description: Die Berliner Philharmoniker Daniel Barenboim und Claudio Abbado brillierten beim Europakonzert 1994 in Meiningen. Die beiden Freunde präsentierten Ludwig van Beethovens 5. Klavierkonzert sowie Johannes Brahms 2. Sinfonie.

classica.us.title: Bach - 5. Brandenburgisches Konzert
classica.us.description: Bei dieser Aufführung im Spiegelsaal des Köthener Schlosses präsentieren Václav Luks und sein Collegium 1704 Bachs Brandenburgisches Konzert Nr. 5 in D-Dur, BWV 1050. Das Cembalo tritt zusammen mit Flöte und Geige in diesem Konzert als Solist auf.

classica.us.title: Fantasymphony: One Concert to Rule them all
classica.us.description: Ein beeindruckendes Konzerterlebnis, das mit einer Mischung aus spektakulären Sound- und Lichteffekten eine ganz besondere Atmosphäre schafft. Mit der Unterstützung eines Chors werden verschiedene Filmmusikstücke komplett neu vertont. - 2020

classica.us.title: Copland - Appalachian Spring
classica.us.description: Die Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería spielt in Mexiko-Stadt unter der Leitung des Dirigenten Carlos Miguel Prieto Aaron Coplands "Appalachian Spring Suite". Diese entstammt Coplands 1944 für Martha Graham komponiertem Ballett.

classica.us.title: Barbarian Nights
classica.us.description: Das Ballett „Barbarian Nights" ist das zweite Werk des Choreografen Hervé Koubi.

classica.us.title: Streichquartett Nr. 7 & 13 und Große Fuge
classica.us.description: Das Streichquartett Quatuor Ébène hat anlässlich des 250. Geburtstages von Ludwig van Beethoven alle 16 Streichquartette des Komponisten aufgenommen. In dieser Sendung spielt Quatuor Ébène Beethovens Streichquartett Nr. 7 in F-Dur, Op. 133.

classica.us.title: Mahler - Symphonie Nr. 6
classica.us.description: Das Publikum schätzt an der Symphonie vor allem ihre tiefgreifende emotionale Ehrlichkeit, ihre unerbittliche Auseinandersetzung mit dem Schicksal und die kraftvolle, fast körperlich spürbare Wirkung der dramatischen Hammerschläge im Finale.

classica.us.title: Ravel - La Valse
classica.us.description: Die russischen Pianisten Nikolay Lugansky und Vadim Rudenko führen Maurice Ravels La Valse in einer Bearbeitung für zwei Klaviere auf. Die Aufführung wurde am 25. November 2021 im Tschaikowsky-Konzertsaal in Moskau aufgezeichnet.

classica.us.title: Bach - 3. Brandenburgisches Konzert
classica.us.description: J. S. Bachs sechs Brandenburgische Konzerte gehören zu seinen bekanntesten Werken. Bei dieser Aufführung im Spiegelsaal des Köthener Schlosses präsentieren Luks und sein Collegium 1704 Bachs brandenburgisches Konzert Nr. 3 in G-Dur.

classica.us.title: Ice Dance: Dornröschen
classica.us.description: Die Imperial Ice Stars, ein Ensemble aus 26 Eiskunstläufern, bieten neue Blickwinkel auf die Geschichte Dornröschens. Aufgenommen 2004 in der Melbourne Theatre Company in Australien mit musikalischer Untermalung von Kompositionen von Tschaikowsky.

classica.us.title: Bruckner - 7. Sinfonie
classica.us.description: In einem Konzert von 2019 im Muziekgebouw in Eindhoven leitet Dirigent Hartmut Haenchen das Orchester der Philharmonie zuidnederland. Das Konzert dreht sich ganz um Anton Bruckners 7. Sinfonie.

themarthastewartchannel.us.title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
themarthastewartchannel.us.description: Martha Stewart offers home cooks a culinary master class which covers everything from roasting and poaching to braising and blanching. Lessons include making marinara sauce with four ingredients, butchering a beef tenderloin, cooking chicken breasts in parchment paper and how to determine which meats are good for braising. thestandupchannel.us.title: Jeff Dunham: Spark of Insanity
thestandupchannel.us.description: Jeff Dunham returns with new ventriloquist characters by starting off with the infamously known Walter, scrutinizing every bit of today's American society.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Tahir Moore: Aging Out
thestandupchannel.us.description: Tahir Moore brings high-energy, no-filter comedy in a wild ride through the zombie apocalypse, fancy toilets, naps, and aging; self-roasting, brutally honest, and always hilarious-this is stand-up with zero chill, big laughs, and all heart.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Bill Engvall: Here's Your Sign: It's Finally Time: My Last Show
thestandupchannel.us.description: Bill Engvall, renowned comedian, entertains audiences for the last time.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Denise Winkelman: Bougie on a Budget
thestandupchannel.us.description: Denise Winkelman mixes sharp wit and heartfelt humor as she shares her journey from a small town with hick parents to life as a transgender woman in Los Angeles, turning struggles into comedy.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Harland Williams: A Force of Nature
thestandupchannel.us.description: Harland Williams performs in the Mojave Desert.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Harland Williams: What a Treat
thestandupchannel.us.description: Stand-up comic Harland Williams takes center stage at the El Rey Theatre in Los Angeles for a riotous evening of laughs; featured topics range from everyman observations on fingernails and fried food to musings on dating and the Pillsbury Doughboy.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Josh Blue: Delete
thestandupchannel.us.description: In his hometown of Denver, Josh Blue discusses the daily details of his life.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Josh Blue: Sticky Change
thestandupchannel.us.description: The "Last Comic Standing"-winning comic performs.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Sara Huntington: Rust Belt Royalty
thestandupchannel.us.description: Sara Huntington shows off the stand-up skills behind her TikTok and Instagram accounts in her debut special from Columbus, Ohio.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Shayne Smith: Prison for Wizards
thestandupchannel.us.description: Comedian and former gang member, Shayne Smith performs in a stand-up special.

thestandupchannel.us.title: William Lee Martin: Standing in the Middle
thestandupchannel.us.description: The Texas comic talks about life, marriage, raising five children and living in a country that's in a constant state of flux.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Tom Green Live
thestandupchannel.us.description: Comic Tom Green hosts.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Michael Yo: Blasian
thestandupchannel.us.description: Michael Yo brings his personal blend of comedy to his debut stand up special; born and raised in Houston, Michael talks about growing up mixed in a place where he really stood out.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Eddie Izzard: Unrepeatable
thestandupchannel.us.description: Highlights of comedian Eddie Izzard's one-man show at London's Albery Theatre in March 1994 when Izzard was playing a limited seven-week run of his celebrated stand-up show.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Andy Sandford: &y S&ford
thestandupchannel.us.description: Andy Sandford dives into the absurd side of life, tackling pharmacists losing their jobs, full-sized houses on the move, and clowns on the edge. Smart, dry, and brutally funny-this is stand-up for people who notice how weird the world really is.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Jesus Trejo: Stay at Home Son
thestandupchannel.us.description: Mexican-American comic Jesus Trejo explores his upbringing as an only child to immigrant parents; he recalls learning many of life's lessons in the most unconventional ways, all the while feeling the need to meet his parents' high expectations.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Katrina Davis: Figuring It Out
thestandupchannel.us.description: Comic and writer Katrina Davis attempts to process the world around her through Southern observations, drug-related sports facts and a theory on why dying alone makes perfect sense.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Jimmy O. Yang: Good Deal
thestandupchannel.us.description: From the Neptune Theater in Seattle, the comic talks about his interactions with immigrant parents, gives his thoughts on Matt Damon and asks whether ghosts are likely to haunt one-bedroom apartments.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Anjelah Johnson: The Homecoming Show
thestandupchannel.us.description: Stand-up comedian Anjelah Johnson returns to San Jose, Calif., for a special performance.

thestandupchannel.us.title: Gabriel Iglesias: I'm Not Fat... I'm Fluffy
thestandupchannel.us.description: The comic known for wearing his signature Hawaiian shirts covers everything from his fondness for Paul Rodriguez to his own "fluffiness."

thestandupchannel.us.title: Gabriel Iglesias: Aloha Fluffy
thestandupchannel.us.description: The comic discusses his crazy world of family, friends, and world travels.

truehistory.us.title: Tocqueville and the American Experiment - An Overview of Democracy in America
truehistory.us.description: The course begins with a brief overview of Tocqueville's masterwork; written to educate the French about democracy; it is originally published as two separate volumes, released five years apart.

truehistory.us.title: Tocqueville and the American Experiment - Alexis de Tocqueville-A Brief Biography
truehistory.us.description: William R. Cook introduces the young French nobleman, trained as a lawyer; his most famous book is only one achievement in a life marked by several; service as France's foreign minister; a history of the French Revolution regarded as a classic.

truehistory.us.title: Tocqueville and the American Experiment - The Journey to America
truehistory.us.description: Tocqueville rarely describes specific events or conversations; his letters and journals allow one to follow him on his trip; getting an excellent feel for the experiences he and his colleague, Gustave de Beaumont, have in America.

truehistory.us.title: Tocqueville and the American Experiment - Equality of Conditions and Freedom
truehistory.us.description: This lecture considers the meaning and implications of what Tocqueville introduces in the first paragraph of "Democracy in America"; the foundation of the democratic enterprise; the concept he calls equality of conditions.

truehistory.us.title: America in the Gilded Age and Progressive Era - 1865: \"Bind Up the Nation's Wounds\"
truehistory.us.description: The key historical forces that characterize the Gilded Age and the Progressive Era; the competing ideals that define these eras; the US in 1865; the extraordinary social, political and economic changes unleashed by the devastation of the Civil War.

truehistory.us.title: America in the Gilded Age and Progressive Era - The Reconstruction Revolution
truehistory.us.description: The Reconstruction era following the Civil War; governmental policies and legislation enacted to safeguard the welfare of former slaves and average citizens; these policies are progressively dismantled, the South comes under the rule of the whites.

truehistory.us.title: America in the Gilded Age and Progressive Era - Buffalo Bill Cody and the Myth of the West
truehistory.us.description: The story of the conquest of the American West; key myths surrounding the West and how it is settled; the motives and realities of westward migration; the components of the western economy; the conflicts with Native Americans that lead to violence.

truehistory.us.title: America in the Gilded Age and Progressive Era - Smokestack Nation: The Industrial Titans
truehistory.us.description: America rises from a developing nation status in 1865 to become a great industrial power by 1900; the unfolding of the American industrial revolution; the advent of big business in the railroad, steel and oil industries; consumerism and advertising.

truehistory.us.title: The Middle Ages Around the World - Medieval Beginnings: The Fall of Empires
truehistory.us.description: Turbulent events that marked the beginning of the Middle Ages.

truehistory.us.title: The Middle Ages Around the World - Constantinople, Aksum, and Tang China
truehistory.us.description: Joyce E. Salisbury provides insight into the relationship between sophisticated medieval cities and their supporters.

truehistory.us.title: The Middle Ages Around the World - The Rise of Islam and Europe's Knights
truehistory.us.description: The expansion of Islam and how people fared under Muslim rule.

truehistory.us.title: The Middle Ages Around the World - Creating an Islamic Culture
truehistory.us.description: The cultural transformations that Muslim rule brought to its domains.

truehistory.us.title: The Vikings - The Vikings in Medieval History
truehistory.us.description: Hostile Christian sources demonize the Vikings; Muslim accounts render them exotic; revisionist historians belittle the Norse raids; archeological finds combined with a study of the Norse sagas enrich the understanding of Scandinavia's medieval past.

truehistory.us.title: The Vikings - Land and People of Medieval Scandinavia
truehistory.us.description: Scandinavia's landscape shapes its culture; dense forestation leads to close-knit communities; woodworking and sailing are the key means of long-distance travel; harsh winters engender skill in cold-weather commute; the emergence of great halls.

truehistory.us.title: The Vikings - Scandinavian Society in the Bronze Age
truehistory.us.description: The physical evidence paints a picture of the Bronze Age in Scandinavia; Viking ancestors trade Arctic goods, amber and slaves in exchange for foreign copper and tin; new wealth fosters larger villages; the beginnings of the Norse pantheon.

truehistory.us.title: The Vikings - Scandinavia in the Celtic and Roman Ages
truehistory.us.description: Scandinavia survives on trade with the Celts; contact with Rome enriches the upper classes; Scandinavians returning from Roman military service bring back advanced weapons and armor; petty kings and the first Scandinavian sailing ships emerge.

truehistory.us.title: Cities of the Ancient World - The Lure of the City
truehistory.us.description: Cities are integral to modern lives; why wandering ancient humans leave the forests and plains to create settlements; the fundamental question of "why" is the first step toward understanding the inhabitants and lessons from ancient cities.

truehistory.us.title: Cities of the Ancient World - Çatalhöyük - First Experiment in Urban Living
truehistory.us.description: Imagining a city with no streets, public buildings or common spaces; the world's first city offers an intriguing window into life in the Neolithic era; exploring the remains of Çatalhöyük's family housing, murals and religious shrines.

truehistory.us.title: Cities of the Ancient World - Jericho and Its Walls
truehistory.us.description: The story of the walls of Jericho in the Book of Joshua; looking past the biblical story; what architectural remains suggest about Jericho, whose ritual spaces help create a community and whose walls help define the urban environment.

truehistory.us.title: Cities of the Ancient World - Uruk - City of Gilgamesh
truehistory.us.description: Looking at one of the most marvelous cities in the ancient world; Uruk exhibits many of the hallmarks of ancient civilization; division of labor among its craftsmen; a class hierarchy that includes professional priests; records of art and literature.

truehistory.us.title: Late Antiquity: Crisis and Transformation - The World of Late Antiquity
truehistory.us.description: Exploring the origin of the term late antiquity; why this historical view better reflects the period from the third to the eighth centuries than the traditional view that Rome has a decline and fall; the major themes and issues of the course.

truehistory.us.title: Late Antiquity: Crisis and Transformation - The Crisis of the 3rd Century
truehistory.us.description: The crisis of the third century, when Rome finds its frontiers threatened on several fronts; armies make and unmake emperors with alarming regularity; the literature of the period also reveals unmistakable feelings of despair and uncertainty.

truehistory.us.title: Late Antiquity: Crisis and Transformation - The New Empire of Diocletian
truehistory.us.description: No one predicts that Rome is about to raise two of its greatest rulers, Diocletian and Constantine; Diocletian institutes a series of reforms that divide the empire into east and west; launching the last and fiercest persecution of Christians.

truehistory.us.title: Late Antiquity: Crisis and Transformation - Constantine's Roman Revolution
truehistory.us.description: Turning to Constantine; how he extends Diocletian's reforms; among them, he gives the empire a new capital at Byzantium, which he renames Constantinople after himself; he also takes the surprising step of legalizing Christianity.
